Interactive preview

Button, Checkbox, Progress, Scroll, Input / TextArea and retained View. Styles provides fonts, density, palettes, geometry and combined-state rules; StyledLabel caches layout. Local themes are complete snapshots. Register measurement with set_style_measure, call mark_measure after text changes, then layout_styled, place_editor and present_styled. Callbacks borrow themes, use node-local coordinates and must not mutate View or topology.

Usage and lifetimes

Extended controls and style switching

Switch, Radio, Slider, Stepper, Tabs, Select, Badge, Divider, Card and ListBox share Styles, combined-state paint rules, shadows and icon placement. Create widgets.style_switcher() to select dark, light or contrast presets. Use use_preset, set_text_scale and set_density, then apply to the retained View; cycle advances and applies a preset. These methods can fail, so handle their errors. Each View receives a complete style snapshot; explicit control overrides remain in effect.

Release examples (complete projects and source downloads): widgets · editor_workbench · style_gallery · controls_gallery

Apply shared styles to a retained View:

@main
#ui/widgets

fn configure(view $&widgets.View) int {
    $themes := widgets.style_switcher()
    themes.use_preset(widgets.THEME_LIGHT) or >>
    themes.set_text_scale(1.2) or >>
    themes.set_density(0.85) or >>
    themes.apply(view) or >>
    // Call this from a theme-switch action to advance and apply the preset.
    themes.cycle(view) or >>
    << 0
}
fn main() int { << 0 }

Component workshop: icon buttons, tooltips and passwords

The complete component_workshop project and source provide 46 entries with themes, density, 100%/140%/200% text, disabled, read-only and invalid states. Use the matching Xu 0.10.11 SDK. A successful Windows/Linux cross build does not establish target-machine GUI acceptance.

Screen.button_with_icon() creates an icon-and-text button; icon_button() creates an icon-only button. Each button owns its style snapshot. Set its own icon_size and ICON_LEADING/TRAILING/ABOVE/BELOW, then use measure_button() to place it at its content size. Embed resources with --www; the code below requires www/logo.png.

Tooltips default to top/center. set_tooltip_placement() selects a side with edge flipping. Ordinary pointer hover shows help after about 500 ms; keyboard or explicit focus shows it immediately. Leaving, clicking or scrolling dismisses it. Escape suppresses the current interaction until re-entry or refocus. Anchors fully outside their scroll clip do not show a tooltip.

password_input() enables a real single-line password Input, with one bullet per Unicode grapheme. set_password_visible() preserves value and selection. Paste works; copy and cut remain blocked when revealed. Native surrounding-text queries and XACP node text do not return the password. text_value() still returns the application value, so applications must manage storage and logging; masking does not encrypt memory.

@main
#ui/widgets

fn configure(screen $&widgets.Screen, styles &widgets.Styles) int {
    button := screen.button_with_icon("logo.png", "Build project") or >>
    $appearance := styles.button_variant(widgets.BUTTON_PRIMARY) or >>
    appearance.icon_placement = widgets.ICON_ABOVE
    appearance.icon_size = 32.0 * styles.text_scale
    screen.set_control_style(button, &appearance) or >>
    size := screen.measure_button(button) or >>
    screen.place(button, 24.0, 24.0, size.width, size.height) or >>
    tip := screen.tooltip(button, "Build project") or >>
    $placement := widgets.overlay_placement()
    placement.side = widgets.OVERLAY_RIGHT
    placement.align = widgets.OVERLAY_CENTER
    screen.set_tooltip_placement(tip, &placement) or >>
    password := screen.password_input("") or >>
    screen.place(password, 24.0, 160.0, 320.0, 48.0) or >>
    << 0
}
fn main() int { << 0 }

// Editor appearance for XU SDK 0.10.11. Other controls retain SDK defaults.
pub fn editor_styles(dark bool) widgets.Styles {
    $styles := widgets.light_styles()
    if dark { styles = widgets.dark_styles() }
    styles.background = canvas(dark)
    $input := styles.input.clone()
    input.radius = 8.0
    input.min_height = 40.0
    input.padding.left = 12.0
    input.padding.right = 12.0
    input.padding.top = 8.0
    input.padding.bottom = 8.0
    input.border_width = 1.0
    input.focus_width = 2.0
    input.font.size = 16.0
    input.inherit_font = false
    input.palette.normal = surface(dark)
    input.palette.hovered = surface(dark)
    input.palette.pressed = subtle(dark)
    input.palette.disabled = surface(dark)
    input.palette.foreground = text(dark)
    input.palette.muted = muted(dark)
    input.palette.placeholder = muted(dark)
    input.palette.accent = brand(dark)
    input.palette.on_accent = on_brand(dark)
    input.palette.focus = focus(dark)
    input.palette.border = control_border(dark)
    input.palette.invalid = danger(dark)
    input.palette.invalid_fill = danger_soft(dark)
    input.palette.read_only = subtle(dark)
    input.palette.selection = brand(dark)
    input.palette.selection_text = on_brand(dark)
    $hover := widgets.state_paint(widgets.STATE_HOVERED)
    hover.unless = widgets.STATE_DISABLED | widgets.STATE_INVALID | widgets.STATE_READ_ONLY
    hover.fields = widgets.PAINT_BORDER
    hover.border = brand(dark)
    $focused := widgets.state_paint(widgets.STATE_FOCUSED)
    focused.unless = widgets.STATE_DISABLED | widgets.STATE_INVALID
    focused.fields = widgets.PAINT_BORDER
    focused.border = focus(dark)
    input.states = [hover,focused]
    styles.input = input.clone()
    styles.text_area = input.clone()
    styles.text_area.align_y = 0.0
    << styles
}

fn document(title string, tone string) string {
    << "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>" + title + "</title><style>body{margin:0;padding:28px;font:15px -apple-system,system-ui;color:#252521;background:#faf9f6}small{letter-spacing:.14em;color:#797970}h1{font-size:28px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:16px 0}p{line-height:1.65;color:#6b6b63}input,button{box-sizing:border-box;font:inherit;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;width:100%;margin:8px 0}input{border:1px solid #d8d8cf;background:white;outline-color:" + tone + "}button{border:0;background:" + tone + ";color:white;cursor:pointer}output{display:block;min-height:42px;padding:12px 0;line-height:1.5;color:" + tone + "}</style></head><body><small>EMBEDDED WEBVIEW</small><h1>" + title + "</h1><p>This document has its own viewport, focus and request identity.</p><input aria-label='Message' value='Hello from " + title + "'><button onclick='send()'>Ask native Xu</button><output aria-live='polite'>Ready for an independent native request.</output><p>Tab moves inside this document.<br>Ctrl + Tab returns to the native controls.</p><script>async function send(){let out=document.querySelector('output');out.textContent='Waiting…';try{out.textContent=await window.__XU__.invoke('echo',document.querySelector('input').value)}catch(e){out.textContent=e.message}}</script></body></html>"
}
fn route(request webview.InvokeRequest) string {
    target := request.target() or(err) { << "Target closed: " + err.msg()}
    script := "document.title"
    options := ui.RequestOptions{timeout_ms: 3000}
    result := ui.webview_request_wait(&target, ui.REQUEST_WEBVIEW_EVAL, &script, &options) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << result.value + " · " + request.payload + " · view " + str(target.canvas_id)
}
fn ipc(events chan ui.Event, emits chan string) {
    webview.bind_ipc_requests_www(":mem:", route, emits, events) or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
        << }
}
fn scene(events chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(events) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ << 0}
    $screen := widgets.screen(&ready) or >>
    screen.resize(1020.0, 720.0) or >>
    screen.set_min_size(760, 580) or >>
    title := screen.label("Web content. Native composition.", 26.0, false) or >>
    subtitle := screen.label("Two independent WebViews inside a Canvas window", 13.0, true) or >>
    hide := screen.button("Hide left") or >>
    reload := screen.button("Reload right") or >>
    close := screen.button("Dispose left") or >>
    modal_button := screen.button("Open modal") or >>
    left := screen.webview() or >>
    right := screen.webview() or >>
    status := screen.label("Resize the window, edit both pages, or test their native requests.", 13.0, true) or >>
    modal := screen.modal("Native overlay", "The WebViews resume when this dialog closes.") or >>
    dismiss := screen.button("Close dialog") or >>
    screen.set_parent(dismiss, modal) or >>
    screen.place(dismiss, 24.0, 175.0, 180.0, 38.0) or >>
    screen.load_web_html(left, document("Editor preview", "#b64c3c")) or >>
    screen.load_web_html(right, document("Reference panel", "#386f6b")) or >>
    $model := Model{left: left, right: right, hide: hide, close: close, status: status, modal: modal, hidden: false, disposed: false}
    $dispatcher := widgets.action_dispatcher(&model, &screen)
    dispatcher.on(hide, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, toggle_left) or >>
    dispatcher.on(reload, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, reload_right) or >>
    dispatcher.on(close, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, dispose_left) or >>
    dispatcher.on(modal_button, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, open_modal) or >>
    dispatcher.on(dismiss, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, close_modal) or >>
    for id in[left, right] {
        dispatcher.on(id, widgets.ACTION_WEB_LOADED, web_loaded) or >>
        dispatcher.on(id, widgets.ACTION_WEB_FAILED, web_failed) or >>
    }
    while screen.is_open() {
        width := screen.width()
        height := screen.height()
        half :=(width - 76.0) * 0.5
        screen.place(title, 28.0, 25.0, width - 56.0, 38.0) or >>
        screen.place(subtitle, 28.0, 69.0, width - 56.0, 25.0) or >>
        screen.place(hide, 28.0, 112.0, 136.0, 38.0) or >>
        screen.place(reload, 174.0, 112.0, 146.0, 38.0) or >>
        screen.place(close, 330.0, 112.0, 136.0, 38.0) or >>
        screen.place(modal_button, 476.0, 112.0, 136.0, 38.0) or >>
        screen.place(left, 28.0, 174.0, half, math.max(300.0, height - 245.0)) or >>
        screen.place(right, 48.0 + half, 174.0, half, math.max(300.0, height - 245.0)) or >>
        screen.place(status, 28.0, height - 49.0, width - 56.0, 28.0) or >>
        _ := screen.render() or >>
        for action in screen.next(events) or >> {
            _ := dispatcher.dispatch(&action, $&model, $&screen) or >>
        }
    }
    screen.dispose()
    << 0
}
fn worker(events chan ui.Event) {scene(events) or(err) {demo.fail(err.msg())
        << }}
fn launch() int {
    $app := demo.app("XUUI / WebView Components", 1020, 720) or >>
    _ := ui.register_content_plugin(ui.content_plugin_webview())
    emits := chan string {cap: 64}
    xu ipc(app.event_ch, emits)
    xu worker(app.event_ch)
    << app.run() or >>
}

        << 1}}

@main

#ui
#ui/widgets

struct Model{left int
    right int
    hide int
    close int
    status int
    modal int
    hidden bool
    disposed bool}
fn toggle_left(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    if m.disposed{ << ""}
    m.hidden = !m.hidden
    screen.set_visible(m.left, !m.hidden) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    if m.hidden{screen.set_text(m.hide, "Show left") or(err) { << err.msg()}} else {screen.set_text(m.hide, "Hide left") or(err) { << err.msg()}}
    << ""
}
fn reload_right(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.webview_command(m.right, "reload") or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn dispose_left(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    if m.disposed{ << ""}
    screen.close_webview(m.left) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    m.disposed = true
    screen.set_enabled(m.hide, false) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    screen.set_enabled(m.close, false) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn open_modal(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.open(m.modal) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn close_modal(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.close_overlay(m.modal) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn web_loaded(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.set_text(m.status, "WebView " + str(action.id) + " loaded independently") or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn web_failed(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.set_text(m.status, "WebView " + str(action.id) + " failed to load") or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}

#ui

demo #"github.com/xulang-org/examples/ui_demo"

struct Model{
    label_id int
    count int
}

fn (m $&Model) layout(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    s.place(m.label_id, 32.0, 36.0, 540.0, 44.0) or >>
    << 0
}

fn inspect_screen(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    $session := xacp.open_session()
    // The in-process adapter follows the current session lifecycle too.
    // This token belongs only to this local demonstration; no listener is opened.
    permissions := xacp.PERM_UI_READ | xacp.PERM_UI_MUTATE
    limits := xacp.default_limits()
    $nonces := xacp.new_nonce_registry(8, true)
    hello := xacp.parse_frame("id: !i 1\nop: xacp.hello\nargs:\n  ver: !ver 1.0.0\n  nonce: local-screen-demo\n  token: local-screen-demo\n  permissions: !i " + str(permissions) + "\n") or(err) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> err
    }
    opened := xacp.dispatch_with_token($&session, &hello, &limits, "local-screen-demo", $&nonces)
    if !opened.ok{
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> errors.new("xacp_screen: " + opened.err_msg)
    }
    tree := xacp.ui_tree(& * s, $&session, 2, false, 0, 32, &limits) or(err) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> err
    }
    println("XACP ui.tree: " + str(tree.nodes.len) + " visible nodes")
    for node in tree.nodes{
        println("  #" + str(node.id) + " kind=" + str(node.kind) + " " + node.text)
    }

    $snapshot := xacp.ui_screenshot(& * s, $&session, 3, 1.0, &limits) or(err) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> err
    }
    println("XACP ui.screenshot: " + str(snapshot.pixel_width) + "x" + str(snapshot.pixel_height) + " pixels")
    snapshot.dispose() or(err) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> err
    }

    _ := xacp.ui_act(& * s, $&session, 2, 4, "focus", "", false, &limits) or(err) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> err
    }
    xacp.close_session($&session)
    << 0
}

fn scene(events chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(events) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ << 0}
    $screen := widgets.screen(&ready) or >>
    screen.resize(640.0, 180.0) or >>
    label_id := screen.label("XACP Screen adapter", 22.0, false) or >>
    button_id := screen.button("Activate locally or through ui.act") or >>
    screen.place(label_id, 32.0, 36.0, 540.0, 44.0) or >>
    screen.place(button_id, 32.0, 96.0, 360.0, 40.0) or >>
    inspect_screen($&screen) or(err) {
        screen.dispose()
        >> err
    }
    $model := Model{label_id: label_id, count: 0}
    $actions := widgets.action_dispatcher(&model, &screen)
    actions.on(button_id, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, activate) or >>
    actions.set_fallback(global_key)
    << widgets.run_screen_actions($&screen, events, $&model, layout_action, &actions) or >>
}

fn worker(events chan ui.Event) {
    scene(events) or(err) {demo.fail(err.msg())
        << }
}

fn launch() int {
    $app := demo.app("Xu / XACP Screen adapter", 640, 180) or >>
    xu worker(app.event_ch)
    << app.run() or >>
}

fn main() int {
    << launch() or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1}
}

fn activate(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.count += 1
    screen.set_text(m.label_id, "Button actions: " + str(m.count)) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn global_key(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_KEY && int(action.value) == ui.KEY_ESCAPE{screen.close() or(err) { << err.msg()}}
    << ""
}
fn layout_action(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen) string {
    m.layout(screen) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}

// One worker owns the controls and their canvas resources. Every recorded
// label remains alive until the complete frame has been accepted.
fn scene(ech chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(ech) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ << 0}
    identity := ui.canvas_of(&ready) or >>
    context := draw.context_of(&ready) or >>
    $switcher := widgets.style_switcher()
    switcher.use_preset(widgets.THEME_LIGHT) or >>
    $toggle := widgets.switch_control(&identity, 1, &rect(48.0, 116.0, 280.0, 48.0), true) or >>
    $radio := widgets.radio(&identity, 2, &rect(48.0, 180.0, 280.0, 48.0), 1, false) or >>
    $slider := widgets.slider(&identity, 3, &rect(48.0, 260.0, 280.0, 36.0), 0.0, 100.0, 50.0) or >>
    slider.set_step(5.0) or >>

    $label4 := widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Two")
    $label5 := widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Three")
    $label6 := widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Select an option")
    $label7 := widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Xu 0.10.2")
    $label8 := widgets.styled_label(&context, &"One")
    $label9 := widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Two")
    $label10 := widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Three")

    for id in 1:8 {dispatcher.on_any(id, control_action) or >> }
    while true {

            frame.begin() or >>

            panel.paint_styled($&frame, &styles) or >>
            ink := styles.button.palette.foreground

            toggle.paint_styled($&frame, $&label0, &styles) or >>
            radio.paint_styled($&frame, $&label1, &styles) or >>
            divider.paint_styled($&frame, &styles) or >>
            slider.paint_styled($&frame, &styles) or >>
            stepper.paint_styled($&frame, $&label2, &styles) or >>
            tabs.paint_box_styled($&frame, &styles) or >>
            list.paint_box_styled($&frame, &styles) or >>
            tabs.paint_tab_styled($&frame, 0, $&label3, &styles) or >>
            list.paint_item_styled($&frame, 0, $&label8, &styles) or >>
            tabs.paint_tab_styled($&frame, 1, $&label4, &styles) or >>
            list.paint_item_styled($&frame, 1, $&label9, &styles) or >>
            tabs.paint_tab_styled($&frame, 2, $&label5, &styles) or >>
            list.paint_item_styled($&frame, 2, $&label10, &styles) or >>
            dropdown.paint_styled($&frame, $&label6, &styles) or >>
            badge.paint_styled($&frame, $&label7, &styles) or >>
            frame.text(32.0, 464.0, 15.0, ink, &"T: theme / S: text size / D: density / Tab: focus / Esc: quit") or >>
            status := "Slider " + str(int(slider.value())) + " / Stepper " + str(int(stepper.value())) + " / Select " + str(dropdown.selected() + 1)
            frame.text(32.0, 494.0, 15.0, ink, &status) or >>
            // A Select popup overlays the scene; this basic painter repeats
            // its label. The selected option index is shown in the status.
            dropdown.paint_popup_styled($&frame, $&label6, &styles) or >>
            // This worker can repaint for a burst of control and appearance actions.
            frame.present_wait() or >>
            toggle.painted()
            radio.painted()
            slider.painted()
            stepper.painted()
            tabs.painted()
            dropdown.painted()
            list.painted()
            state.dirty = false
        }
        event := demo.next(ech)
        if event.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ <- }
        if event.window_id != identity.window_id{ -> }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_CLOSED{ <- }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_METRICS{state.dirty = true}
        if ui.is_input_event(event.kind) {
            input := ui.input_of(&event) or >>
            if input.generation != identity.generation{ -> }
            if input.kind == ui.EV_KEY_DOWN && input.repeat == 0 {

                    // another frame while the native host is closing.

            }
        }
        // Route the popup first. A modal option click must not also focus
        // or activate the ListBox underneath it.
        popup_open := dropdown.is_open()
        first := dropdown.event(&event) or >>
        $actions :=[first]
        if !popup_open && !first.consumed{
            actions.push(toggle.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(radio.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(slider.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(stepper.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(tabs.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(list.event(&event) or >>)
        }
        for action in actions{
            if !(dispatcher.dispatch(&action, $&state, $&switcher) or >>) {
                // ACTION_NONE may carry focus/repaint metadata without a semantic event.
                action_state($&state, &action)
            }
        }
        toggle.set_focus(state.focus == 1)
        radio.set_focus(state.focus == 2)
        slider.set_focus(state.focus == 3)
        stepper.set_focus(state.focus == 4)
        tabs.set_focus(state.focus == 5)
        dropdown.set_focus(state.focus == 6)
        list.set_focus(state.focus == 7)
    }
    frame.dispose()
    if demo.alive(&identity) {
        label0.dispose()
        label1.dispose()
        label2.dispose()
        label3.dispose()
        label4.dispose()
        label5.dispose()
        label6.dispose()
        label7.dispose()
        label8.dispose()
        label9.dispose()
        label10.dispose()
    }
    << 0
}
fn worker(ech chan ui.Event) {
    scene(ech) or(err) {demo.fail(err.msg())
        << }
}
fn launch() int {
    $app := demo.app("Xu UI / Extended Controls", 780, 552) or >>
    xu worker(app.event_ch)
    << app.run() or >>
}
fn main() int {
    << launch() or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1}
}

struct Model{dirty bool
    focus int}
fn action_state(m $&Model, action &widgets.Action) {
    if action.request_focus{m.focus = action.id}
    if action.needs_paint{m.dirty = true}
}
fn control_action(m $&Model, switcher $&widgets.StyleSwitcher, action &widgets.Action) string {
    action_state(m, action)
    << ""
}

fn appearance_key(switcher $&widgets.StyleSwitcher, input &ui.InputEvent) bool {
    if input.key == 84 || input.key == 116 {switcher.next() or >>
        << true}
    if input.key == 83 || input.key == 115 {
        $scale := 1.4
        if switcher.text_scale() > 1.0 {scale = 1.0}
        switcher.set_text_scale(scale) or >>
        << true
    }
    if input.key == 68 || input.key == 100 {
        $density := 0.85
        if switcher.density() < 1.0 {density = 1.0}
        switcher.set_density(density) or >>
        << true
    }
    << false
}

fn (m &Model) fill_table(screen $&widgets.Screen) int {
    names :=["Compiler", "Widgets", "Runtime", "Desktop", "Examples", "Tooling"]
    states :=["Ready", "Review", "Ready", "Draft", "Ready", "Review"]
    clocks :=["10:30", "11:15", "09:40", "12:00", "10:05", "08:50"]
    $order :=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    col := screen.sort_column(m.table) or >>
    if col == 0 {order =[0, 3, 4, 2, 5, 1]}
    if col == 1 {order =[3, 0, 2, 4, 1, 5]}
    if col == 2 {order =[5, 2, 4, 0, 1, 3]}
    desc := screen.sort_descending(m.table) or >>
    page :=(screen.selected(m.pager) or >>) + 1
    for row in 0:6 {
        $slot := row
        if desc{slot = 5 - row}
        i := order[slot]
        screen.set_cell(m.table, row, 0, names[i] + " / " + str(page)) or >>
        screen.set_cell(m.table, row, 1, states[i]) or >>
        screen.set_cell(m.table, row, 2, clocks[i]) or >>
    }
    << 0
}

    for id in[table, tree, pager, captions[0], captions[1]] {screen.set_parent(id, pages[0]) or >> }

    for id in overlay_buttons{screen.set_parent(id, pages[2]) or >> }

fn page_0(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.page = 0
    << ""
}
fn page_1(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.page = 1
    << ""
}
fn page_2(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.page = 2
    << ""
}
fn choose_theme(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.theme =(m.theme + 1) % 3
    m.appearance_dirty = true
    << ""
}
fn choose_scale(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    if m.text_scale == 1.0 {m.text_scale = 1.4} else {m.text_scale = 1.0}
    m.appearance_dirty = true
    << ""
}
fn choose_density(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    if m.density == 1.0 {m.density = 0.8} else {m.density = 1.0}
    m.appearance_dirty = true
    << ""
}
fn refresh_table(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.fill_table(screen) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn open_popover(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.open(m.popover) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn open_modal(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.open(m.modal) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn notify_theme(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    _ := screen.notify("All components share the same theme.") or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn complete_modal(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.close_overlay(m.modal) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    _ := screen.notify("Action completed.") or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn close_modal(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.close_overlay(m.modal) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn changed(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.set_text(m.note, "Value changed · Tab / Shift+Tab · Escape") or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn page_changed(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.fill_table(screen) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << changed(m, screen, action)
}
fn inputs_changed(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    value := screen.text_value(m.combo) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    count :=(screen.values(m.multi) or(err) { << err.msg()}).len
    screen.set_text(m.value_label, "Value: " + value + "    Selected tags: " + str(count)) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << changed(m, screen, action)
}
fn global_key(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_KEY && int(action.value) == ui.KEY_ESCAPE{screen.close() or(err) { << err.msg()}}
    << ""
}
fn register_actions(m &Model, screen &widgets.Screen) widgets.ActionDispatcher#Model, widgets.Screen, widgets.Action{
    $d := widgets.action_dispatcher(m, screen)
    d.on(m.nav[0], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, page_0) or >>
    d.on(m.nav[1], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, page_1) or >>
    d.on(m.nav[2], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, page_2) or >>
    d.on(m.settings[0], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, choose_theme) or >>
    d.on(m.settings[1], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, choose_scale) or >>
    d.on(m.settings[2], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, choose_density) or >>
    d.on(m.table, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, refresh_table) or >>
    d.on(m.overlay_buttons[0], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, open_popover) or >>
    d.on(m.overlay_buttons[1], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, open_modal) or >>
    d.on(m.overlay_buttons[2], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, notify_theme) or >>
    d.on(m.modal_actions[0], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, complete_modal) or >>
    d.on(m.modal_actions[1], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, close_modal) or >>
    for id in[m.table, m.tree, m.crumbs, m.color] {d.on(id, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, changed) or >> }
    d.on(m.pager, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, page_changed) or >>
    d.on(m.combo, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, inputs_changed) or >>
    d.on(m.multi, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, inputs_changed) or >>
    // Screen-wide keys have id 0, outside the by-id control namespace.
    d.set_fallback(global_key)
    << d
}

fn layout_action(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen) string {
    apply_appearance(m, screen) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    m.layout(screen) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""

fn apply_appearance(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen) int {
    if !m.appearance_dirty{ << 0}
    $styles := widgets.preset_styles(m.theme) or >>
    styles.text_scale = m.text_scale
    styles.density = m.density
    appearance := widgets.screen_appearance(&styles, screen.reduced_motion()) or >>
    screen.apply_appearance(&appearance) or >>
    m.appearance_dirty = false
    << 0
}

fn scene(ech chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(ech) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ << 0}
    identity := ui.canvas_of(&ready) or >>
    context := draw.context_of(&ready) or >>
    host := widgets.Host{context: context, identity: identity}
    $column := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_COLUMN)
    column.padding = layout.insets(28.0) or >>
    column.gap = 14.0
    column.cross_alignment = layout.CROSS_STRETCH
    $view := host.view(&column, demo.background()) or >>
    leaf := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_LEAF)
    header := view.add(view.root(), &leaf, &layout.Size{width: 400.0, height: 72.0}) or >>
    button_id := view.add(view.root(), &leaf, &layout.Size{width: 280.0, height: 44.0}) or >>
    check_id := view.add(view.root(), &leaf, &layout.Size{width: 280.0, height: 40.0}) or >>
    progress_id := view.add(view.root(), &leaf, &layout.Size{width: 280.0, height: 12.0}) or >>
    $viewport := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_COLUMN)
    viewport.height = 220.0
    viewport.clip = true
    viewport.cross_alignment = layout.CROSS_STRETCH
    viewport.gap = 6.0
    scroll_id := view.add(view.root(), &viewport, &layout.Size{width: 400.0, height: 220.0}) or >>
    $rows :=[]int {}
    for _ in 0:20 {
        row := view.add(scroll_id, &leaf, &layout.Size{width: 400.0, height: 32.0}) or >>
        rows.push(row)
        view.set_boundary(row, true) or >>
    }
    for id in[header, button_id, check_id, progress_id, scroll_id] {view.set_boundary(id, true) or >> }
    for id in[button_id, check_id, scroll_id] {view.set_input(id, true, true) or >> }
    empty := layout.Rect{x: 0.0, y: 0.0, width: 0.0, height: 0.0}
    options := draw.text_options(15.0)
    first := "Complete one action"
    second := "Enable action button"
    $model := Model{button: widgets.button(&identity, button_id, &empty) or >>,
        checkbox: widgets.checkbox(&identity, check_id, &empty, true) or >>,
        progress: widgets.progress(&empty, 0.0) or >>,
        scroll: widgets.scroll(&identity, scroll_id, &empty, widgets.AXIS_VERTICAL, 760.0) or >>,
        button_label: context.layout_text(&first, &options) or >>,
        checkbox_label: context.layout_text(&second, &options) or >>,
        theme: widgets.default_theme(), context: context, count: 0, header_id: header, button_id: button_id, check_id: check_id, progress_id: progress_id, scroll_id: scroll_id, row_ids: rows}
    dispatcher := register_actions(&model, &view) or >>
    $width := 700.0
    $height := 600.0
    while true {
        constraints := layout.tight(width, height) or >>
        submitted := widgets.present($&view, &constraints, $&model) or >>
        if submitted{model.acknowledge()}
        event := demo.next(ech)
        if event.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ <- }
        if event.window_id != identity.window_id{ -> }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_METRICS{
            metrics := ui.metrics_of(&event) or >>
            if metrics.width > 0.0 && metrics.height > 0.0 {width = metrics.width
                height = metrics.height}
        }
        actions := widgets.dispatch_event($&view, &event, $&model) or >>
        for action in actions{_ := dispatcher.dispatch(&action, $&model, $&view) or >> }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_CLOSED{ <- }
        if ui.is_input_event(event.kind) {
            input := ui.input_of(&event) or >>
            if input.kind == ui.EV_KEY_DOWN && input.key == ui.KEY_ESCAPE{demo.quit() or >> }
        }
        stats := view.stats()
        if stats.recorded_boundaries > 0 || stats.reused_boundaries > 0 {
            println("View: " + str(stats.recorded_boundaries) + " recorded / " + str(stats.reused_boundaries) + " reused boundaries")
        }
    }
    view.dispose()
    // Native close revokes resources; only release user handles while live.
    if demo.alive(&identity) {
        label := $&model.button_label
        label.dispose() or >>
        check_label := $&model.checkbox_label
        check_label.dispose() or >>
    }
    << 0
}
fn worker(ech chan ui.Event) {scene(ech) or(err) {demo.fail(err.msg())
        << }}
fn launch() int {
    $app := demo.app("Xu UI / Retained Controls", 700, 600) or >>
    xu worker(app.event_ch)

fn activate(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.View, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.advance() or(err) { << err.msg()}
    screen.mark_paint(m.header_id) or(err) { << err.msg()}

    << ""
}

    << ""

    d.on(m.check_id, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, enable) or >>
    d.on(m.scroll_id, widgets.ACTION_SCROLL, scroll) or >>
    << d
}

fn (m $&Model) work(screen $&widgets.Screen, now time.Instant) int {
    if !m.running || now.before(m.next_work) { << 0}
    // Each progress update follows an actual bounded work batch. The pause
    // represents an application work queue and never changes the percentage.
    for i in 0:5000 {m.checksum =(m.checksum + i *(m.completed + 1)) % 1000003}
    m.completed = m.completed + 1
    _ := screen.set_task_progress(m.task, m.task_id, f64(m.completed) / 48.0) or >>
    m.next_work = now.add(time.milliseconds(35) or >>) or >>
    if m.fail_next && m.completed == 18 {
        _ := screen.complete_task(m.task, m.task_id, widgets.TASK_ERROR) or >>
        m.running = false
        m.fail_next = false
        screen.set_text(m.message, "Example failure. Retry starts a new task; stale progress is rejected.") or >>
    } else if m.completed == 48 {
        _ := screen.complete_task(m.task, m.task_id, widgets.TASK_SUCCESS) or >>
        m.running = false
        screen.set_text(m.message, "48/48 work batches completed · checksum " + str(m.checksum)) or >>
    }
    << 0
}

fn search_changed(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    query := screen.text_value(m.search) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    screen.set_tree_filter(m.tree, query) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn name_changed(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.set_field_invalid(m.name, false) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn node_action(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    _ := screen.notify("Node action · " + str(int(action.value))) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn slider_committed(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.set_text(m.message, "Slider committed · " + str(int(action.value))) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn toggle_controls(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.show_controls = !m.show_controls
    << ""
}
fn queue_notice(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    $notice := widgets.notice(&"Saved a local configuration")
    notice.action = "Undo"
    _ := screen.enqueue_notice(&notice) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn choose_theme(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.theme_index =(m.theme_index + 1) % 3
    m.appearance_dirty = true
    << ""
}
fn choose_guides(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.guided = !m.guided
    m.appearance_dirty = true
    << ""
}
fn choose_density(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.compact = !m.compact
    m.appearance_dirty = true
    << ""
}
fn choose_motion(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.reduced = !m.reduced
    m.appearance_dirty = true
    << ""
}
fn choose_failure(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.fail_next = !m.fail_next
    << ""
}
fn start_task(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    if m.running{ << ""}
    name := screen.text_value(m.name) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    if name.len == 0 {screen.set_field_invalid(m.name, true) or(err) { << err.msg()}
        screen.focus(m.name) or(err) { << err.msg()}
        << ""}
    m.task_id = m.task_id + 1
    m.completed = 0
    m.checksum = 0
    m.running = true
    m.next_work = time.instant()
    screen.begin_task(m.task, m.task_id) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn cancel_task(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    if !m.running{ << ""}
    _ := screen.complete_task(m.task, m.task_id, widgets.TASK_CANCELLED) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    m.running = false
    screen.set_text(m.message, "Task cancelled. Completed work remains " + str(m.completed) + "/48.") or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn notice_action(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.Screen, action &widgets.Action) string {
    screen.set_text(m.message, "Notification action · " + str(int(action.value))) or(err) { << err.msg()}
    << ""
}
fn register_actions(m &Model, screen &widgets.Screen) widgets.ActionDispatcher#Model, widgets.Screen, widgets.Action{
    $d := widgets.action_dispatcher(m, screen)
    d.on(m.search, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, search_changed) or >>
    d.on(m.name, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, name_changed) or >>
    d.on(m.tree, widgets.ACTION_ITEM_ACTION, node_action) or >>
    d.on(m.extras[5], widgets.ACTION_COMMIT, slider_committed) or >>
    d.on(m.controls_page, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, toggle_controls) or >>
    d.on(m.extras[19], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, queue_notice) or >>
    d.on(m.theme, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, choose_theme) or >>
    d.on(m.guides, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, choose_guides) or >>
    d.on(m.density, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, choose_density) or >>
    d.on(m.effects, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, choose_motion) or >>
    d.on(m.failure, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, choose_failure) or >>
    d.on(m.task, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, start_task) or >>
    d.on(m.cancel, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, cancel_task) or >>
    << d
}
fn register_notices(screen &widgets.Screen, d $&widgets.ActionDispatcher#Model, widgets.Screen, widgets.Action) int {
    for id in screen.notice_ids() {d.on(id, widgets.ACTION_NOTICE_ACTION, notice_action) or >> }
    << 0
}

        << control.route(kind, event) or >> }
    if id == model.body_id{control := $&model.body
        << control.route(kind, event) or >> }

fn (model $&Model) draw_node(id int,frame $&draw.Frame) int {
    styles := model.styles.clone()
    if id == model.title_id { control := $&model.title
        control.paint_styled(frame,&styles) or >> }
    else if id == model.body_id { control := $&model.body
        control.paint_styled(frame,&styles) or >> }
    else if id == model.header {
        demo.text(&model.context,frame,0.0,0.0,24.0,tokens.text(model.dark),"Writing desk") or >>
        demo.text(&model.context,frame,0.0,34.0,14.0,tokens.muted(model.dark),"XUUI design standard · native text and menu controls") or >>
        demo.text(&model.context,frame,0.0,62.0,14.0,tokens.muted(model.dark),"Tab / Shift+Tab · drag selection · copy / cut / paste · arrows / Home / End") or >>
    } else if id == model.footer {
        demo.text(&model.context,frame,0.0,0.0,14.0,tokens.brand(model.dark),"Changes: " + str(model.changes) + "  |  " + model.status) or >>
        demo.text(&model.context,frame,0.0,27.0,14.0,tokens.muted(model.dark),"Use the Document menu: toggle editing, reset, query screens. Escape quits.") or >>
    }
    << 0
}

    body := $&model.body
    widgets.place_editor(view, body) or >>

}

fn menus(window &ui.Window,enabled bool,dark bool) int {
    $entries := [ui.submenu("document","Document",-1)]
    $reset := ui.menu_action("reset","Reset note",0)
    reset.key = 82
    reset.modifiers = ui.MENU_PRIMARY | ui.MOD_SHIFT
    entries.push(reset)
    entries.push(ui.menu_check("editing","Enable editing",0,enabled))
    entries.push(ui.menu_separator(0))
    entries.push(ui.submenu("display","Displays",0))
    $query := ui.menu_action("screens","Query current screens",4)
    query.key = 68
    query.modifiers = ui.MENU_PRIMARY | ui.MOD_SHIFT
    entries.push(query)
    $unavailable := ui.menu_action("unavailable","Unavailable action",4)
    unavailable.enabled = false
    entries.push(unavailable)
    entries.push(ui.menu_check("dark-theme","Dark appearance",0,dark))
    << window.set_menu_entries(entries) or >>
}
fn scene(ech chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(ech) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ << 0}
    identity := ui.canvas_of(&ready) or >>
    context := draw.context_of(&ready) or >>
    window := ui.Window{id: identity.window_id, generation: identity.generation, title: "", width: 0, height: 0, content_kind: ui.CONTENT_DRAW, content_backend_id: identity.canvas_id, closed: 0}
    menus(&window, true, false) or >>
    host := widgets.Host{context: context, identity: identity}
    $column := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_COLUMN)
    column.padding = layout.insets(24.0) or >>
    column.gap = 16.0
    column.cross_alignment = layout.CROSS_STRETCH
    $view := host.view(&column, tokens.canvas(false)) or >>
    leaf := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_LEAF)
    header := view.add(view.root(), &leaf, &layout.Size{width: 500.0, height: 88.0}) or >>
    title_id := view.add(view.root(), &leaf, &layout.Size{width: 500.0, height: 44.0}) or >>
    body_id := view.add(view.root(), &leaf, &layout.Size{width: 500.0, height: 260.0}) or >>
    footer := view.add(view.root(), &leaf, &layout.Size{width: 500.0, height: 72.0}) or >>
    for id in[header, title_id, body_id, footer] {view.set_boundary(id, true) or >> }
    for id in[title_id, body_id] {view.set_input(id, true, true) or >> }
    empty := layout.Rect{x: 0.0, y: 0.0, width: 0.0, height: 0.0}
    $model := Model{title: widgets.input(&context, &identity, title_id, &empty, &"Untitled note") or >>,
        body: widgets.text_area(&context, &identity, body_id, &empty, &"Write here.\n你好，Xu。\n\nSelection and IME are native; layout and painting stay in the retained View.") or >>,
        context: context, styles: tokens.editor_styles(false), dark: false, header: header, title_id: title_id, body_id: body_id, footer: footer, changes: 0, status: "Ready"}
    $dispatcher := widgets.action_dispatcher(&model, &view)
    dispatcher.on(title_id, widgets.ACTION_SUBMIT, submit_title) or >>
    $width := 820.0
    $height := 620.0
    $enabled := true
    options := ui.RequestOptions{timeout_ms: 5000}
    $screens := window.screens_async(&options) or >>
    $event := ui.Event{kind: ui.EV_NONE, window_id: 0, menu_id: "", width: 0, height: 0}
    // Native text snapshots already carry the latest revision. Drain queued
    // edits before painting so a key burst cannot fill the frame queue.
    while true {
        if event.kind == ui.EV_NONE{
            constraints := layout.tight(width, height) or >>
            _ := view.layout(&constraints) or >>
            model.place($&view) or >>
            submitted := widgets.present($&view, &constraints, $&model) or >>
            if submitted{
                first := $&model.title
                first.painted()
                second := $&model.body
                second.painted()
            }
            event = demo.next(ech)
        }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ <- }
        if event.window_id != identity.window_id{event = ui.poll_chan(ech)
            -> }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_METRICS{metrics := ui.metrics_of(&event) or >>
            width = metrics.width
            height = metrics.height}
        actions := widgets.dispatch_event($&view, &event, $&model) or >>
        if model.native_event(&event) or >> {model.changes = model.changes + 1
            view.mark_paint(footer) or >> }
        for action in actions{_ := dispatcher.dispatch(&action, $&model, $&view) or >> }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_MENU_CLICKED{
            if event.menu_id == "reset" {model.reset() or >> }
            if event.menu_id == "editing" {enabled = !enabled
                model.editing(enabled) or >>
                for id in[title_id, body_id] {view.set_input(id, enabled, enabled) or >> }
                menus(&window, enabled, model.dark) or >> }
            if event.menu_id == "dark-theme" {
                model.dark = !model.dark
                model.styles = tokens.editor_styles(model.dark)
                view.set_background(tokens.canvas(model.dark))
                for id in [header,title_id,body_id,footer] { view.mark_paint(id) or >> }
                menus(&window,enabled,model.dark) or >>
            }
            if event.menu_id == "screens" {screens.cancel()
                screens = window.screens_async(&options) or >> }
        }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_REQUEST{result := ui.request_of(&event) or >>
            if result.matches(&screens) && result.status == ui.REQUEST_COMPLETED{
                displays := ui.screen_result(&result) or >>
                model.status = str(displays.len) + " display(s)"
                for display in displays{println("Screen: " + display.name + " / " + str(int(display.bounds.width)) + " x " + str(int(display.bounds.height)) + " / scale " + str(int(display.scale_x)))
                    if display.current{model.status = display.name + " · " + str(int(display.bounds.width)) + " x " + str(int(display.bounds.height))}}
                view.mark_paint(footer) or >>
            }
        }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_CLOSED || event.kind == ui.EV_CLOSED{ <- }
        if ui.is_input_event(event.kind) {input := ui.input_of(&event) or >>
            if input.kind == ui.EV_KEY_DOWN && input.key == ui.KEY_ESCAPE{demo.quit() or >> }}
        event = ui.poll_chan(ech)
    }
    screens.cancel()
    view.dispose()
    << 0
}
fn worker(ech chan ui.Event) {scene(ech) or(err) {demo.fail(err.msg())
        << }}
fn main() int {
    $app := demo.app("Xu UI / Writing Desk", 820, 620) or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1}
    xu worker(app.event_ch)
    << app.run() or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1}
}

    << true
}
fn (model $&Model) draw_node(id int, bounds &layout.Rect, frame $&draw.Frame) int {
    if id == model.header_id{
        demo.text(&model.context, frame, 0.0, 0.0, 14.0, demo.accent(), "07 / IMAGE WORKBENCH") or >>
        demo.text(&model.context, frame, 0.0, 28.0, 24.0, demo.ink(), "Image workbench") or >>
        demo.text(&model.context, frame, 0.0, 58.0, 13.0, demo.muted(), model.message + "") or >>
    } else if id == model.button_id{
        model.place_button(bounds) or >>
        model.button.paint(frame, &model.button_label, &model.theme) or >>
    } else if id == model.check_id{
        model.place_checkbox(bounds) or >>
        model.checkbox.paint(frame, &model.checkbox_label, &model.theme) or >>
    } else if id == model.progress_id{
        model.place_progress(bounds) or >>
        model.progress.paint(frame, &model.theme) or >>
    } else if id == model.scroll_id{
        scroll := $&model.scroll
        scroll.set_bounds(bounds) or >>
        frame.fill_rect(0.0, 0.0, bounds.width, bounds.height, draw.rgb(26, 37, 50)) or >>
    } else if model.row_ids.len > 0 && id == model.row_ids[0] {
        if model.images.len > 0 {
            image := model.images[0]
            scale := math.min(bounds.width / f64(image.width), bounds.height / f64(image.height))
            frame.image(&image, 0.0, 0.0, f64(image.width) * scale, f64(image.height) * scale) or >>

    }
    << 0

        control.paint_scrollbar(f, s) or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
            << false}}
    if id == 1 &&(m.select_ctrl.is_open() || m.popup_motion.value() > 0.0) {
        m.paint_select_popup(s, f) or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
            << false}
    }
    << true
}
// Root overlay keeps the popup above every sibling and outside the button's box.
fn (m $&Model) paint_select_popup(s &widgets.Styles, f $&draw.Frame) int {
    $control := m.select_ctrl.clone()
    control.set_open(true)
    opacity := m.popup_motion.value()
    if opacity <= 0.0 { << 0}
    base := control.style_or(s)
    appearance := base.with_opacity(opacity) or >>
    control.set_style(&appearance) or >>
    popup := control.popup_bounds(s)
    $offset := - 4.0 *(1.0 - opacity)
    if popup.y < 0.0 {offset = 4.0 *(1.0 - opacity)}
    f.push() or >>
    f.translate(m.select_origin.x, m.select_origin.y + offset) or >>
    control.paint_popup_box_styled(f, s) or >>
    auto_label := $&m.option_auto
    control.paint_option_styled(f, 0, auto_label, s) or >>
    manual_label := $&m.option_manual
    control.paint_option_styled(f, 1, manual_label, s) or >>
    locked_label := $&m.option_locked
    control.paint_option_styled(f, 2, locked_label, s) or >>
    f.pop() or >>
    << 0
}
// The popup is an overlay, so route its pointer sequence before normal tree hits.
fn (m $&Model) dispatch_input(view $&widgets.View, event &ui.InputEvent)[]widgets.Action{
    was_open := m.select_ctrl.is_open()
    pointer := event.kind == ui.EV_POINTER_DOWN || event.kind == ui.EV_POINTER_UP ||
    event.kind == ui.EV_POINTER_MOVE || event.kind == ui.EV_POINTER_SCROLL
    if pointer &&(was_open || m.select_popup_armed) {
        local := view.local_input(41, event) or >>
        styles := view.styles_for(41) or >>
        pop := m.select_ctrl.popup_bounds(&styles)
        if pop.contains(local.x, local.y) || m.select_popup_armed{
            if event.kind == ui.EV_POINTER_DOWN && event.button == ui.BUTTON_LEFT{m.select_popup_armed = true}
            control := $&m.select_ctrl
            action := control.input(&local) or >>
            view.set_pointer_cursor(ui.CURSOR_HAND) or >>
            if event.kind == ui.EV_POINTER_UP{m.select_popup_armed = false}
            view.mark_paint(41) or >>
            view.mark_paint(1) or >>
            <<[action]
        }
    }
    if event.kind == ui.EV_POINTER_CANCEL{m.select_popup_armed = false}
    actions := widgets.dispatch(view, event, m) or >>
    if was_open || m.select_ctrl.is_open() {view.mark_paint(1) or >> }
    << actions
}
fn (m $&Model) dispatch_event(view $&widgets.View, event &ui.Event)[]widgets.Action{
    if ui.is_input_event(event.kind) {
        input := ui.input_of(event) or >>
        << m.dispatch_input(view, &input) or >>
    }
    was_open := m.select_ctrl.is_open()
    actions := widgets.dispatch_event(view, event, m) or >>
    m.select_popup_armed = false
    if was_open && !m.select_ctrl.is_open() {view.mark_paint(1) or >> }
    << actions
}

fn (m $&Model) place(view $&widgets.View) int {
    select_bounds := view.node_bounds(41) or >>
    m.select_origin = select_bounds
    select_styles := view.styles_for(41) or >>
    select_control := $&m.select_ctrl
    select_control.set_bounds(&layout.Rect{x: 0.0, y: 0.0, width: select_bounds.width, height: select_bounds.height}) or >>
    select_control.apply_styles(&select_styles) or >>
    popup := select_control.popup_bounds(&select_styles)
    window_bounds := view.node_bounds(1) or >>
    below := window_bounds.y + window_bounds.height - select_bounds.y - select_bounds.height
    above := select_bounds.y - window_bounds.y
    select_control.set_popup_above(below < popup.height + 2.0 * select_styles.density && above > below)
    list_bounds := view.node_bounds(43) or >>
    list_styles := view.styles_for(43) or >>
    list_control := $&m.list
    list_control.set_bounds(&layout.Rect{x: 0.0, y: 0.0, width: list_bounds.width, height: list_bounds.height}) or >>
    list_control.apply_styles(&list_styles) or >>
    input := $&m.input
    widgets.place_editor(view, input) or >>
    invalid := $&m.invalid
    widgets.place_editor(view, invalid) or >>
    read_only := $&m.read_only
    widgets.place_editor(view, read_only) or >>
    area := $&m.area
    widgets.place_editor(view, area) or >>
    bounds := view.node_bounds(16) or >>
    styles := view.styles_for(16) or >>
    control := $&m.scroll
    control.set_bounds(&layout.Rect{x: 0.0, y: 0.0, width: bounds.width, height: bounds.height}) or >>
    control.apply_styles(&styles) or >>
    view.set_scroll(16, 0.0, control.offset()) or >>
    << 0
}
fn (m $&Model) native_event(view $&widgets.View, event &ui.Event) int {
    input := $&m.input
    action_12 := input.event(event) or >>
    if action_12.needs_paint{view.mark_paint(12) or >> }
    invalid := $&m.invalid
    action_13 := invalid.event(event) or >>
    if action_13.needs_paint{view.mark_paint(13) or >> }
    read_only := $&m.read_only
    action_14 := read_only.event(event) or >>
    if action_14.needs_paint{view.mark_paint(14) or >> }
    area := $&m.area
    action_15 := area.event(event) or >>
    if action_15.needs_paint{view.mark_paint(15) or >> }
    << 0
}

fn leaf(view $&widgets.View, parent int, width f64, height f64) int {
    style := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_LEAF)
    << view.add(parent, &style, &layout.Size{width: width, height: height}) or >>
}
fn brand_scope(view $&widgets.View) int {
    $brand := widgets.light_styles()
    brand.button.palette.normal = draw.rgb(10, 91, 69)
    brand.button.palette.hovered = draw.rgb(17, 120, 90)
    brand.button.palette.pressed = draw.rgb(7, 65, 49)
    brand.button.palette.foreground = draw.rgb(255, 255, 255)
    brand.button.font.size = 17.0
    brand.button.font.weight = 600
    brand.button.inherit_font = false
    brand.button.radius = 18.0
    brand.button.icon_size = 22.0
    brand.button.icon_placement = widgets.ICON_TRAILING
    $hover := widgets.state_paint(widgets.STATE_HOVERED)
    hover.unless = widgets.STATE_DISABLED
    hover.fields = widgets.PAINT_FOREGROUND | widgets.PAINT_BORDER
    hover.foreground = draw.rgb(209, 250, 229)
    hover.border = draw.rgb(110, 231, 183)
    brand.button.states =[hover]
    brand.button.shadow = draw.rgba(0, 0, 0, 28)
    brand.button.shadow_y = 2.0
    brand.button.shadow_blur = 6.0
    view.set_style_scope(8, &brand) or >>
    << 0
}
fn scene(ech chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(ech) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ << 0}
    identity := ui.canvas_of(&ready) or >>
    context := draw.context_of(&ready) or >>
    host := widgets.Host{context: context, identity: identity}
    $column := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_COLUMN)
    column.padding = layout.insets(22.0) or >>
    column.gap = 10.0
    column.cross_alignment = layout.CROSS_STRETCH
    $view := host.view(&column, draw.rgb(20, 25, 34)) or >>
    _ := leaf($&view, 1, 400.0, 56.0) or >>  // 2 header
    $row := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_ROW)
    row.gap = 12.0
    row.cross_alignment = layout.CROSS_CENTER
    _ := view.add(1, &row, &layout.Size{width: 0.0, height: 0.0}) or >>  // 3 toolbar
    for i in 0:3 {_ := leaf($&view, 3, 0.0, 0.0) or >> }  // 4..6
    _ := view.add(1, &row, &layout.Size{width: 0.0, height: 0.0}) or >>  // 7 controls
    for i in 0:3 {_ := leaf($&view, 7, 0.0, 0.0) or >> }  // 8..10
    _ := leaf($&view, 1, 300.0, 12.0) or >>  // 11 progress
    for i in 0:4 {_ := leaf($&view, 1, 300.0, 0.0) or >> }  // 12..15 editors
    $viewport := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_COLUMN)
    viewport.height = 84.0
    viewport.clip = true
    viewport.cross_alignment = layout.CROSS_STRETCH
    _ := view.add(1, &viewport, &layout.Size{width: 0.0, height: 0.0}) or >>  // 16 scroll
    $items := layout.box_style(layout.BOX_COLUMN)
    items.gap = 6.0
    items.cross_alignment = layout.CROSS_STRETCH
    _ := view.add(16, &items, &layout.Size{width: 0.0, height: 0.0}) or >>  // 17 items
    for i in 0:12 {_ := leaf($&view, 17, 300.0, 28.0) or >> }  // 18..29
    _ := leaf($&view, 1, 400.0, 42.0) or >>  // 30 footer
    _ := view.add(1, &row, &layout.Size{width: 0.0, height: 0.0}) or >>  // 31 extended controls row 1
    for i in 0:6 {_ := leaf($&view, 31, 0.0, 0.0) or >> }  // 32..37: switch, radio_a, radio_b, slider, stepper, badge
    _ := leaf($&view, 1, 300.0, 0.0) or >>  // 38 labeled divider
    _ := view.add(1, &row, &layout.Size{width: 0.0, height: 0.0}) or >>  // 39 extended controls row 2
    for i in 0:4 {_ := leaf($&view, 39, 0.0, 0.0) or >> }  // 40..43: tabs, select, card, list_box
    for id in[2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 30, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 40, 41, 42, 43] {view.set_boundary(id, true) or >> }
    for id in[4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 40, 41, 43] {view.set_input(id, true, true) or >> }
    view.set_capture_outside(16, true) or >>
    view.set_capture_outside(35, true) or >>
    for id in[4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 40, 41, 42, 43] {view.set_style_measure(id, true) or >> }
    empty := layout.Rect{x: 0.0, y: 0.0, width: 0.0, height: 0.0}
    $m := Model{theme: widgets.button(&identity, 4, &empty) or >>, scale: widgets.button(&identity, 5, &empty) or >>,
        density: widgets.button(&identity, 6, &empty) or >>, brand: widgets.button(&identity, 8, &empty) or >>,
        disabled: widgets.button(&identity, 9, &empty) or >>, check: widgets.checkbox(&identity, 10, &empty, true) or >>,
        toggle: widgets.switch_control(&identity, 32, &empty, true) or >>,
        radio_a: widgets.radio(&identity, 33, &empty, 0, true) or >>,
        radio_b: widgets.radio(&identity, 34, &empty, 1, false) or >>,
        slider: widgets.slider(&identity, 35, &empty, 0.0, 100.0, 64.0) or >>,
        stepper: widgets.stepper(&identity, 36, &empty, 0.0, 100.0, 5.0, 65.0) or >>,
        tabs: widgets.tabs(&identity, 40, &empty, 3, 0) or >>,
        select_ctrl: widgets.select_box(&identity, 41, &empty, 3, 0) or >>,
        select_origin: empty, select_popup_armed: false,
        transitions:[]widgets.PaintTransition{}, switch_motion: widgets.tween(1.0) or >>, popup_motion: widgets.tween(0.0) or >>,
        clock: time.zero_instant(), reduced_motion: false, theme_index: 0, text_scale: 1.0, density_scale: 1.0, appearance_dirty: true,
        badge: widgets.badge(&empty) or >>,
        divider: widgets.divider(&empty, widgets.AXIS_HORIZONTAL) or >>,
        card: widgets.card(&empty) or >>,
        list: widgets.list_box(&identity, 43, &empty, 4, 0) or >>,
        input: widgets.input(&context, &identity, 12, &empty, &"Editable input · 你好 Xu") or >>,
        invalid: widgets.input(&context, &identity, 13, &empty, &"Invalid value — custom error colors") or >>,
        read_only: widgets.input(&context, &identity, 14, &empty, &"Read-only · select and copy, edits are ignored") or >>,
        area: widgets.text_area(&context, &identity, 15, &empty, &"TextArea uses the same font, padding and selection theme.\nIME, preedit and caret geometry follow typography changes.") or >>,
        progress: widgets.progress(&empty, 0.64) or >>, scroll: widgets.scroll(&identity, 16, &empty, widgets.AXIS_VERTICAL, 402.0) or >>,
        context: context, icon: context.load_embedded_image(&"logo.png") or >>, switcher: widgets.style_switcher(),
        theme_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Theme: dark / light / contrast"),
        scale_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Text: 100% / 140%"),
        density_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Density: normal / compact"),
        brand_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Local green"),
        disabled_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Disabled"),
        check_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Checkbox"),
        toggle_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Switch"),
        radio_a_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Radio A"),
        radio_b_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Radio B"),
        stepper_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"65"),
        badge_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Active"),
        divider_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Navigation & Data Components"),
        card_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Card Panel"),
        tab_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Overview"),
        tab_2_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Tokens"),
        tab_3_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Themes"),
        select_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Option: Auto"),
        option_auto: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Auto"),
        option_manual: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Manual"),
        option_locked: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"Locked"),
        list_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"1 · Buttons"),
        list_2_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"2 · Editors"),
        list_3_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"3 · Surfaces"),
        list_4_label: widgets.styled_label(&context, &"4 · Controls")}
    for i in 0:44 {m.transitions.push(widgets.paint_transition() or >>)}
    for id in[4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 32, 33, 34, 36, 40, 41, 43] {view.set_cursor(id, ui.CURSOR_HAND) or >> }
    for id in[12, 13, 14, 15] {view.set_cursor(id, ui.CURSOR_TEXT) or >> }
    view.set_cursor(35, ui.CURSOR_RESIZE_HORIZONTAL) or >>
    badge_ref := $&m.badge
    badge_ref.set_selected(true)
    disabled := $&m.disabled
    disabled.set_enabled(false)
    invalid := $&m.invalid
    invalid.set_invalid(true)
    read_only := $&m.read_only
    read_only.set_read_only(true) or >>
    apply_appearance($&m, $&view) or >>
    brand_scope($&view) or >>
    dispatcher := register_actions(&m, &view) or >>
    $width := 960.0
    $height := 820.0
    $event := ui.Event{kind: ui.EV_NONE, window_id: 0, menu_id: "", width: 0, height: 0}
    // Drain input bursts before painting. Native text snapshots already hold
    // the latest revision; rendering each queued key would fill the frame queue.
    ui.request_canvas_preferences(&identity) or >>
    while true {
        if event.kind == ui.EV_NONE{
            apply_appearance($&m, $&view) or >>
            m.tick($&view, time.instant()) or >>
            constraints := layout.tight(width, height) or >>
            _ := widgets.layout_styled($&view, &constraints, $&m) or >>
            m.place($&view) or >>
            if widgets.present_styled($&view, &constraints, $&m) or >> {m.acknowledge()}
            event = m.next_event(ech)
        }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ <- }
        if event.window_id == identity.window_id{
            if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_CLOSED || event.kind == ui.EV_CLOSED{ <- }
            if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_METRICS{metrics := ui.metrics_of(&event) or >>
                width = metrics.width
                height = metrics.height}
            if event.kind == ui.EV_FOCUSED{ui.request_canvas_preferences(&identity) or >> }
            if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_PREFERENCES{
                preferences := ui.canvas_preferences_of(&event) or >>
                if preferences.identity.canvas_id == identity.canvas_id && preferences.identity.generation == identity.generation{
                    m.reduced_motion = preferences.reduced_motion
                    view.mark_paint(1) or >>
                }
            }
            popup_was_open := m.select_ctrl.is_open()
            actions := m.dispatch_event($&view, &event) or >>
            m.native_event($&view, &event) or >>
            for action in actions{_ := dispatcher.dispatch(&action, $&m, $&view) or >> }
            if ui.is_input_event(event.kind) {input := ui.input_of(&event) or >>
                if input.kind == ui.EV_KEY_DOWN && input.key == ui.KEY_ESCAPE && !popup_was_open{
                    view.dispose()
                    if demo.alive(&identity) {m.cleanup()}
                    demo.quit() or >>
                    << 0
                }}
        }
        event = ui.poll_chan(ech)
    }
    view.dispose()
    if demo.alive(&identity) {m.cleanup()}
    << 0
}
fn worker(ech chan ui.Event) {scene(ech) or(err) {demo.fail(err.msg())
        << }}
fn main() int {
    $app := demo.app("Xu UI / Style Gallery", 960, 820) or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1}
    xu worker(app.event_ch)
    << app.run() or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1}
}
    Xuevents.xu
    @main

fn choose_theme(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.View, action &widgets.Action) string {
    m.theme_index =(m.theme_index + 1) % 3
    m.appearance_dirty = true
    << ""
}
fn choose_scale(m $&Model, screen $&widgets.View, action &widgets.Action) string {
    if m.text_scale == 1.0 {m.text_scale = 1.4} else {m.text_scale = 1.0}
    m.appearance_dirty = true

fn apply_appearance(m $&Model, view $&widgets.View) int {
    if !m.appearance_dirty{ << 0}
    theme := m.theme_index

    m.appearance_dirty = false

#ui
#ui/widgets
#time
demo #"github.com/xulang-org/examples/ui_demo"

fn scene(events chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(events) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT{ << 0}
    $screen := widgets.screen(&ready) or >>
    screen.resize(1180.0, 900.0) or(err) {screen.dispose()
        >> err}
    screen.set_min_size(920, 780) or(err) {screen.dispose()
        >> err}
    $model := create($&screen) or(err) {screen.dispose()
        >> err}
    workshop_loop(events, $&model, $&screen) or(err) {screen.dispose()
        >> err}
    screen.dispose()
    << 0
}

fn worker(events chan ui.Event) {scene(events) or(err) {demo.fail(err.msg())
        << }}

fn launch() int {
    $app := demo.app("XUUI / Component Workshop", 1180, 900) or >>
    xu worker(app.event_ch)
    << app.run() or >>
}

fn main() int { << launch() or(err) {eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1}}

fn next_event(events chan ui.Event, deadline time.Instant) ui.Event{
    if deadline.is_zero() { << <- events}
    delay := deadline.since(time.instant())
    if delay.nanoseconds() <= 0 { << ui.Event{kind: ui.EV_NONE, window_id: 0, menu_id: "", width: 0, height: 0}}
    timer := delay.timer()
    select {event := <- events{timer.stop()
            << event}
        _ := <- timer.c{timer.stop()}}
    << ui.Event{kind: ui.EV_NONE, window_id: 0, menu_id: "", width: 0, height: 0}
}

fn workshop_loop(events chan ui.Event, model $&Workshop, screen $&widgets.Screen) int {
    model.apply_locale(screen) or >>
    screen.set_text(model.title, "XUUI  /  Field") or >>
    model.configure_controls(screen) or >>
    model.controls_dirty = false
    model.apply_appearance(screen) or >>
    model.appearance_dirty = false
    $dispatcher := register_events(& * model, & * screen) or >>
    model.layout(screen) or >>
    while screen.is_open() {
        register_notice_events(& * screen, $&dispatcher) or >>
        now := time.instant()
        model.work(screen, now) or >>
        if model.controls_dirty{model.configure_controls(screen) or >>
            model.controls_dirty = false}
        if model.appearance_dirty{model.apply_appearance(screen) or >>
            model.appearance_dirty = false}
        model.apply_page_options(screen) or >>
        model.layout(screen) or >>
        $deadline := screen.advance(now) or >>
        $timed_actions := false
        for action in screen.take_actions() {
            _ := dispatcher.dispatch_or_fallback(&action, model, screen) or >>
            timed_actions = true
        }
        // Reconcile timer-driven values/styles before computing the next wait.
        if timed_actions{ -> }
        _ := screen.render() or >>
        if model.running &&(deadline.is_zero() || model.deadline.before(deadline)) {deadline = model.deadline}
        event := next_event(events, deadline) or >>
        $actions := screen.event(&event) or >>
        $count := 0
        while screen.is_open() && count < 128 {pending := ui.poll_chan(events)
            if pending.kind == ui.EV_NONE{ <- }
            more := screen.event(&pending) or >>
            for action in more{actions.push(action)}
            count += 1}
        for action in actions{register_notice_events(& * screen, $&dispatcher) or >>
            _ := dispatcher.dispatch_or_fallback(&action, model, screen) or >> }
    }
    << 0
}

// Each control ID has one owner-specific handler. No page-number update switch.
fn register_events(m &Workshop, s &widgets.Screen) widgets.ActionDispatcher#Workshop, widgets.Screen, widgets.Action{
    $d := widgets.action_dispatcher(m, s)
    for page in m.pages{for id in page.ids{d.on_any(id, sample_action) or >> }}
    d.on(m.navigation, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, navigate) or >>
    d.on(m.language, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, language_changed) or >>
    for id in[m.theme, m.density, m.scale, m.reduced] {d.on(id, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, appearance_changed) or >> }
    d.on(m.state, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, state_changed) or >>
    d.on(m.custom, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, custom_clicked) or >>
    d.on(m.motion, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, motion_clicked) or >>
    d.on(m.focus, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, focus_clicked) or >>
    for id in m.tools{d.on(id, widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, tool_clicked) or >> }
    for i in 0:4 {d.on(m.pages[1].ids[9 + i], widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, appearance_changed) or >> }
    d.on(m.pages[7].ids[1], widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, tree_filter_changed) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[7].ids[0], widgets.ACTION_ITEM_ACTION, node_action) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[8].ids[0], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, task_clicked) or >>
    for kind in[widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, widgets.ACTION_COMMIT] {
        d.on(m.pages[13].ids[0], kind, slider_changed) or >>
        d.on(m.pages[20].ids[0], kind, color_changed) or >>
        d.on(m.pages[40].ids[0], kind, range_changed) or >>
    }
    d.on(m.pages[17].ids[1], widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, multi_filter_changed) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[24].ids[0], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, table_sorted) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[25].ids[0], widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, pagination_changed) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[25].ids[2], widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, page_size_changed) or >>
    for kind in[widgets.ACTION_SUBMIT, widgets.ACTION_COMMIT] {d.on(m.pages[25].ids[1], kind, page_submitted) or >> }
    d.on(m.pages[25].ids[4], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, page_submitted) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[30].ids[1], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, inbox_clicked) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[30].ids[2], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, online_clicked) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[33].ids[0], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, preferences_open) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[33].ids[6], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, preferences_cancel) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[33].ids[7], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, preferences_apply) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[35].ids[0], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, notice_clicked) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[36].ids[0], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, modal_open) or >>
    for i in 2:4 {d.on(m.pages[36].ids[i], widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, modal_close) or >> }
    for id in m.pages[38].ids{for kind in[widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE] {d.on(id, kind, group_changed) or >> }}
    d.on(m.pages[39].ids[1], widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, chart_kind_changed) or >>
    for kind in[widgets.ACTION_CHART_HOVER, widgets.ACTION_CHART_SELECT] {d.on(m.pages[39].ids[0], kind, chart_hit) or >> }
    d.on(m.pages[39].ids[0], widgets.ACTION_CHART_VIEWPORT, chart_viewport_changed) or >>
    d.on(m.pages[41].ids[0], widgets.ACTION_COMMIT, split_committed) or >>
    for page in 42:45 {for kind in[widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE, widgets.ACTION_CHANGE] {d.on(m.pages[page].ids[0], kind, menu_action) or >> }}
    d.on(m.pages[45].ids[1], widgets.ACTION_CHANGE, password_visibility_changed) or >>
    for kind in[widgets.ACTION_WEB_LOADING, widgets.ACTION_WEB_LOADED, widgets.ACTION_WEB_FAILED, widgets.ACTION_WEB_PROGRESS] {
        d.on(m.pages[37].ids[0], kind, webview_changed) or >>
    }
    << d
}
fn register_notice_events(s &widgets.Screen, d $&widgets.ActionDispatcher#Workshop, widgets.Screen, widgets.Action) int {
    for id in s.notice_ids() {d.on(id, widgets.ACTION_NOTICE_ACTION, notice_action) or >> }
    << 0
}

    handlers :=[tool_0, tool_1, tool_2, tool_3, tool_4, tool_5, tool_6, tool_7, tool_8, tool_9, tool_10, tool_11, tool_none, tool_13, tool_none, tool_15, tool_16, tool_17, tool_18, tool_19, tool_20, tool_none, tool_none, tool_none, tool_24, tool_25, tool_none, tool_27, tool_28, tool_none, tool_30, tool_none, tool_32, tool_33, tool_34, tool_35, tool_36, tool_37, tool_38, tool_39, tool_40, tool_41, tool_42, tool_43, tool_44, tool_45]
    for i in 0:3 {if a.id == m.tools[i] {handler := handlers[m.selected]
            message := handler(m, s, i)
            if message.len > 0 { >> errors.new(message)}
            << 0}}
    << 0
}
