#ui/widgets
#ui/layout
#math

fn focusable_sample(index int) bool { << index != 0 && index != 27 && index != 28 && index != 29 && index != 30}

fn (m &Workshop) layout(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    styles := s.styles()
    scale := math.max(1.0, styles.text_scale)
    width := s.width()
    height := s.height()
    gap := 16.0
    rail := 216.0 + 40.0 *(scale - 1.0)
    x := rail + 48.0
    right := width - x - 24.0
    row := math.max(40.0 * styles.density, 36.0 * scale)
    s.place(m.title, 24.0, 20.0, width - 48.0, 36.0 * scale) or >>
    $top := 36.0 * scale + 32.0
    items :=[m.theme, m.density, m.scale, m.state]
    part :=(width - 48.0 - gap * 3.0) / 4.0
    for i in 0:4 {s.place(items[i], 24.0 + f64(i) *(part + gap), top, part, row) or >> }
    top += row + 12.0
    s.place(m.custom, 24.0, top, part, row) or >>
    s.place(m.motion, 24.0 + part + gap, top, part, row) or >>
    s.place(m.reduced, 24.0 +(part + gap) * 2.0, top, part, row) or >>
    s.place(m.focus, 24.0 +(part + gap) * 3.0, top, part, row) or >>
    top += row + 24.0
    s.place(m.navigation, 24.0, top, rail, height - top - row - 36.0) or >>
    s.place(m.language, 24.0, height - row - 24.0, rail, row) or >>
    s.place(m.caption, x, top, right, 58.0 * scale) or >>
    control_top := top + 66.0 * scale + 16.0
    content := math.max(100.0, right - 48.0)
    // Keep complete action labels at large text sizes. The toolbar shares the
    // preview's scroll area so wrapping never pushes the sample off the window.
    $columns := 3
    if content < 780.0 * scale{columns = 2}
    if content < 520.0 * scale{columns = 1}
    column :=(content - f64(columns - 1) * 12.0) / f64(columns)
    tool_names := tool_labels(m.selected)
    $tool_count := 0
    for i in 0:3 {if tool_names[i].len > 0 {
            s.place(m.tools[i], 24.0 + f64(tool_count % columns) *(column + 12.0), 24.0 + f64(tool_count / columns) *(row + 12.0), column, row) or >>
            tool_count += 1}}
    $tool_extent := 0.0
    if tool_count > 0 {tool_extent = f64((tool_count + columns - 1) / columns) *(row + 12.0) + 16.0}
    bottom := height - 56.0 * scale - 24.0
    s.place(m.preview, x, control_top, right, math.max(100.0, bottom - control_top)) or >>
    s.place(m.status, x, math.max(bottom + 12.0, control_top + 112.0), right, 52.0 * scale) or >>
    for i in 0:m.pages.len{s.set_visible(m.pages[i].group, i == m.selected) or >> }
    position := m.selected
    pages := &m.pages
    page := &pages[position]
    s.place(page.group, 0.0, tool_extent, right, 1000.0 * scale) or >>
    id := page.ids[0]
    $h := row
    if m.selected == 0 {h = 180.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 4 {h = 220.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 5 {h = 96.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 6 {h = 210.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 7 || m.selected == 23 || m.selected == 24 || m.selected == 32 || m.selected == 37 {h = 320.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 12 {h = 144.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 13 {h = 80.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 20 {h = 280.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 27 {h = 16.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 28 {h = 54.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 29 {h = 28.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 30 {h = 320.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 31 {h = 280.0 * scale}
    $y := 24.0
    if m.selected == 7 || m.selected == 17 {s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, 24.0, content, 86.0 * scale) or >>
        y += 102.0 * scale}
    $sample_width := content
    if m.selected == 2 {sample_width = row
        h = row}
    if m.selected != 30 && m.selected != 1 {s.place(id, 24.0, y, sample_width, h) or >> }
    if m.selected == 1 {
        buttons := m.page_snapshot(1)
        h = layout_buttons(s, &buttons, content, row, scale) or >>
    }
    if m.selected == 34 {
        size := s.measure_button(id) or >>
        width := math.min(content, math.ceil(size.width))
        s.place(id, 24.0 +(content - width) * 0.5, y + 100.0 * scale, width, math.max(row, size.height)) or >>
        h = math.max(row, size.height) + 200.0 * scale
    }
    if m.selected == 0 {s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, y + h + 16.0, content, 48.0 * scale) or >>
        h += 80.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 13 {s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, y + h + 24.0, content, 100.0 * scale) or >>
        h += 148.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 25 {
        $summary_height := 28.0 * scale
        if content < 650.0 && scale > 1.4 {summary_height = 56.0 * scale}
        s.place(page.ids[3], 24.0, y, content, summary_height) or >>
        page_y := y + summary_height + 12.0 * scale
        s.place(id, 24.0, page_y, content, row) or >>
        cy := page_y + row + 28.0 * scale
        size_width := math.min(content, 150.0 * scale)
        input_width := 112.0 * scale
        go_width := 88.0 * scale
        $input_x := 40.0 + size_width
        $input_y := cy
        if size_width + input_width + go_width + 32.0 > content{
            input_x = 24.0
            input_y = cy + row + 32.0 * scale}
        s.place(page.ids[2], 24.0, cy, size_width, row) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[1], input_x, input_y - 8.0 * styles.density, input_width, row + 8.0 * styles.density) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[4], input_x + input_width + 16.0, input_y, go_width, row) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[5], 24.0, input_y + row + 12.0 * scale, content, 40.0 * scale) or >>
        h = input_y - y + row + 64.0 * scale
    }
    if m.selected == 33 {
        s.place(id, 24.0, y, math.min(content, 200.0 * scale), row) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[1], 0.0, 0.0, 360.0 * scale, 340.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[2], 24.0 * scale, 20.0 * scale, 312.0 * scale, 30.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[3], 24.0 * scale, 58.0 * scale, 312.0 * scale, 66.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[4], 24.0 * scale, 132.0 * scale, 312.0 * scale, 88.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[5], 24.0 * scale, 224.0 * scale, 312.0 * scale, row) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[6], 24.0 * scale, 280.0 * scale, 148.0 * scale, row) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[7], 188.0 * scale, 280.0 * scale, 148.0 * scale, row) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[8], 24.0, y + row + 20.0 * scale, content, 64.0 * scale) or >>
        h = row + 100.0 * scale
    }
    if m.selected == 20 {s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, y + h + 24.0, content, 96.0 * scale) or >>
        h += 124.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 28 || m.selected == 29 {s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, y + h + 12.0, content, 36.0 * scale) or >>
        h += 60.0 * scale}
    if m.selected == 30 {
        button_width := math.min(content - 16.0, 220.0 * scale)
        s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, y, button_width, row) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[6], 24.0, y + row + 14.0 * scale, content, 36.0 * scale) or >>
        ay := y + row + 78.0 * scale
        s.place(page.ids[2], 24.0, ay, 56.0 * scale, 56.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[7], 100.0 * scale, ay, math.max(1.0, content - 100.0 * scale), 32.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[8], 100.0 * scale, ay + 34.0 * scale, math.max(1.0, content - 100.0 * scale), 40.0 * scale) or >>
        sy := ay + 106.0 * scale
        tag := s.badge_size(page.ids[4]) or >>
        beta := s.badge_size(page.ids[5]) or >>
        label_width := 220.0 * scale
        $tx := 24.0
        $ty := sy + 44.0 * scale
        if label_width + tag.width + beta.width + 32.0 <= content{
            s.place(page.ids[9], 24.0, sy, label_width, 32.0 * scale) or >>
            tx = 40.0 + label_width
            ty = sy
        } else {s.place(page.ids[9], 24.0, sy, content, 32.0 * scale) or >> }
        s.place(page.ids[4], tx, ty, tag.width, tag.height) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[5], tx + 16.0 + tag.width, ty, beta.width, beta.height) or >>
        h = ty + math.max(tag.height, 32.0 * scale)
    }
    if m.selected == 31 {s.place(page.ids[4], 0.0, 0.0, content - 32.0, 36.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[5], 0.0, 0.0, content - 32.0, 110.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[6], 0.0, 0.0, content - 32.0, row) or >> }
    if m.selected == 32 {s.set_scroll_extent(id, 14.0 *(row + 16.0) + 24.0) or >>
        for i in 1:page.ids.len{s.place(page.ids[i], 12.0, 12.0 + f64(i - 1) *(row + 16.0), content - 44.0, row) or >> }}
    if m.selected == 38 {
        height := row
        $group_h := height
        if m.group_vertical{group_h = row * 3.0}
        $group_width := content
        if m.group_vertical{group_width = math.min(content, 260.0 * scale)}
        for i in 0:3 {cy := y + f64(i) *(group_h + 40.0 * scale)
            s.place(page.ids[3 + i], 24.0, cy, content, 24.0 * scale) or >>
            s.place(page.ids[i], 24.0, cy + 28.0 * scale, group_width, group_h) or >> }
        h = 3.0 *(group_h + 40.0 * scale)
    }
    if m.selected == 39 {
        $selector_h := row
        $selector := widgets.button_group_appearance()
        selector.equal_width = true
        if scale > 1.4 && content < 560.0 {selector.vertical = true
            selector_h = row * 5.0}
        s.set_button_group_appearance(page.ids[1], &selector) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, y, content, selector_h) or >>
        s.place(id, 24.0, y + selector_h + 20.0, content, math.max(320.0, 320.0 * scale)) or >>
        h = selector_h + 340.0 * scale
    }
    if m.selected >= 40 {h = m.interaction_layout(s, row, scale, content) or >> }
    if m.selected == 36 {s.place(page.ids[2], 24.0 * scale, 190.0 * scale, 170.0 * scale, row) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[3], 210.0 * scale, 190.0 * scale, 170.0 * scale, row) or >> }
    s.set_scroll_extent(m.preview, tool_extent + y + h + 32.0) or >>
    << 0
}

fn layout_buttons(s $&widgets.Screen, page &Page, content f64, row f64, scale f64) f64 {
    stepper_width := math.min(content, 160.0 * scale)
    label_height := 24.0 * scale
    inspector_height := label_height + 8.0 + row + 12.0
    $cy := 24.0
    // Keep each direction pair together when it fits, then wrap by the native
    // measured size rather than stretching every example across the preview.
    for group in 0:2 {
        $x := 24.0
        $line_height := 0.0
        for i in(group * 2):(group * 2 + 2) {
            size := s.measure_button(page.ids[i]) or >>
            width := math.min(content, math.ceil(size.width))
            height := math.max(row, math.ceil(size.height))
            column := math.max(width, stepper_width)
            if x > 24.0 && x + column > 24.0 + content{
                x = 24.0
                cy += line_height + 12.0
                line_height = 0.0
            }
            s.place(page.ids[13 + i], x, cy, column, label_height) or >>
            s.place(page.ids[9 + i], x, cy + label_height + 8.0, stepper_width, row) or >>
            s.place(page.ids[i], x, cy + inspector_height, width, height) or >>
            x += column + 16.0
            line_height = math.max(line_height, inspector_height + height)
        }
        cy += line_height + 20.0
    }
    $x := 24.0
    $line_height := 0.0
    for i in 4:9 {
        size := s.measure_button(page.ids[i]) or >>
        width := math.min(content, math.ceil(size.width))
        height := math.max(row, math.ceil(size.height))
        if x > 24.0 && x + width > 24.0 + content{
            x = 24.0
            cy += line_height + 12.0
            line_height = 0.0
        }
        s.place(page.ids[i], x, cy, width, height) or >>
        x += width + 12.0
        line_height = math.max(line_height, height)
    }
    cy += line_height + 20.0
    << cy - 24.0
}

fn (m &Workshop) interaction_layout(s $&widgets.Screen, row f64, scale f64, content f64) f64 {
    position := m.selected
    pages := &m.pages
    page := &pages[position]
    id := page.ids[0]
    if m.selected == 45 {
        width := math.min(content, 380.0 * scale)
        label_height := 28.0 * scale
        input_height := math.max(row, 48.0 * s.styles().density)
        input_y := 24.0 + label_height + 8.0
        s.place(page.ids[2], 24.0, 24.0, width, label_height) or >>
        s.place(id, 24.0, input_y, width, input_height) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, input_y + input_height + 16.0, content, row) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[3], 24.0, input_y + input_height + row + 36.0, content, 100.0 * scale) or >>
        << label_height + input_height + row + 160.0 * scale
    }
    if m.selected == 40 {
        $width := content
        $height := 104.0 * scale
        if m.range_vertical{width = math.min(content, 160.0 * scale)
            height = 300.0 * scale}
        s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, 24.0, content, 32.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(id, 24.0, 64.0 * scale, width, height) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[2], 24.0, 80.0 * scale + height, content, 64.0 * scale) or >>
        << height + 144.0 * scale
    }
    if m.selected == 41 {
        height := 320.0 * scale
        s.place(id, 24.0, 24.0, content, height) or >>
        boxes := s.split_layout(id) or >>
        for pane in 0:2 {
            $width := boxes.first.width
            $height := boxes.first.height
            if pane == 1 {width = boxes.second.width
                height = boxes.second.height}
            inner := math.max(1.0, width - 32.0)
            caption_height := math.max(1.0, math.min(100.0 * scale, height - row - 48.0))
            s.place(page.ids[3 + pane], 16.0, 16.0, inner, caption_height) or >>
            s.set_visible(page.ids[5 + pane], height >= row + 32.0) or >>
            s.place(page.ids[5 + pane], 16.0, math.max(16.0, height - row - 16.0), inner, row) or >>
        }
        << height
    }
    if m.selected >= 42 && m.selected <= 44 {
        $width := math.min(content, 240.0 * scale)
        $height := row
        if m.selected == 43 {width = content
            height = 180.0 * scale}
        s.place(id, 24.0, 24.0, width, height) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[1], 24.0, height + 44.0 * scale, content, 44.0 * scale) or >>
        s.place(page.ids[2], 24.0, height + 100.0 * scale, content, 80.0 * scale) or >>
        << height + 180.0 * scale
    }
    << row
}

#ui/widgets

struct Page{group int
    ids []int}
// A state transition may reconfigure Workshop while these control IDs are in
// use. Copy the IDs; Screen keeps ownership of the actual controls.

fn (m &Workshop) page_snapshot(index int) Page{
    group := m.pages[index].group
    $ids :=[]int {}
    for id in m.pages[index].ids{ids.push(id)}
    << Page{group: group, ids: ids}
}

struct Workshop{
    controls_dirty bool
    field_options_page int
    appearance_dirty bool
    tree_options_dirty bool
    field_options_dirty bool
    spinner_options_dirty bool
    popover_options_dirty bool
    tooltip_side int
    range_push bool
    range_vertical bool
    range_commit bool
    split_vertical bool
    split_collapsed bool
    menu_stays_open bool
    menu_export_disabled bool
    chart_kind int
    chart_paused bool
    group_vertical bool
    group_joined bool
    group_disabled bool
    pages []Page
    names []string
    navigation int
    language int
    preview int
    title int
    caption int
    status int
    theme int
    density int
    scale int
    state int
    custom int
    reduced int
    motion int
    focus int
    tools []int
    selected int
    customized bool
    guided bool
    slow bool
    variant int
    revision int
    completed int
    running bool
    failure bool
    pending_before bool
    pagination_error bool
    preferences_name string
    preferences_history bool
    unread int
    online bool
    checksum int
    deadline time.Instant
}

fn create(s $&widgets.Screen) Workshop{
    labels := names()
    $pages :=[]Page{}
    preview := s.scroll_area(widgets.AXIS_VERTICAL, 760.0) or >>
    for index in 0:labels.len{page := new_page(s, index) or >>
        s.set_parent(page.group, preview) or >>
        pages.push(page)}
    title := s.label("", 25.0, false) or >>
    caption := s.label("", 13.0, true) or >>
    s.set_label_wrapped(caption, true) or >>
    status := s.label("Hover · press · Tab · arrows · Escape / 使用真实鼠标与键盘状态", 12.0, true) or >>
    s.set_label_wrapped(status, true) or >>
    navigation := s.list_box(&labels, 5) or >>
    language := s.select_box(&["中文", "English", "Custom"], 1) or >>
    _ := s.tooltip(language, "Component language · 组件默认文案与格式") or >>
    tools :=[s.button("Option 1") or >>, s.button("Option 2") or >>, s.button("Option 3") or >>]
    for tool in tools{s.set_parent(tool, preview) or >> }
    << Workshop{controls_dirty: true, field_options_page: 5, appearance_dirty: true, tree_options_dirty: false, field_options_dirty: false, spinner_options_dirty: false, popover_options_dirty: false, tooltip_side: widgets.OVERLAY_TOP, range_push: false, range_vertical: false, range_commit: false, split_vertical: false, split_collapsed: false, menu_stays_open: false, menu_export_disabled: false, chart_kind: 0, chart_paused: false, group_vertical: false, group_joined: true, group_disabled: false, language: language, pages: pages, names: labels, navigation: navigation, preview: preview, title: title, caption: caption, status: status,
        theme: s.select_box(&["Light 亮色", "Dark 暗色", "Contrast 对比"], 1) or >>,
        density: s.select_box(&["Normal 常规", "Compact 紧凑", "Touch 触控"], 0) or >>,
        scale: s.select_box(&["Text 100%", "Text 140%", "Text 200%"], 0) or >>,
        state: s.select_box(&["Normal 普通", "Disabled 禁用", "Read only 只读", "Invalid 错误"], 0) or >>,
        custom: s.button("Default 默认") or >>, reduced: s.checkbox("Reduce 减少动效", false) or >>,
        motion: s.button("Motion 160ms") or >>, focus: s.button("Focus sample") or >>,
        tools: tools, selected: 5, customized: false, guided: true, slow: false,
        variant: 0, revision: 0, completed: 0, running: false, failure: false, pending_before: false, pagination_error: false, preferences_name: "XU workspace", preferences_history: true, unread: 12, online: true, checksum: 0, deadline: time.zero_instant()}
}

fn (m $&Workshop) apply_locale(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    index := s.selected(m.language) or >>
    $locale := widgets.locale_en_us()
    if index != 1 {locale = widgets.locale_zh_cn()}
    if index == 2 {
        locale.set_text(widgets.TEXT_TODAY, "回到今天") or >>
        locale.set_text(widgets.TEXT_CLEAR, "移除日期") or >>
        locale.set_text(widgets.TEXT_DATE_PLACEHOLDER, "预约日期") or >>
        locale.set_text(widgets.TEXT_DATE_PATTERN, "{day}.{month}.{year}") or >>
        locale.set_text(widgets.TEXT_DECIMAL_SEPARATOR, ",") or >>
        locale.set_text(widgets.TEXT_GROUP_SEPARATOR, " ") or >>
        locale.set_weekdays(&["周日", "周一", "周二", "周三", "周四", "周五", "周六"]) or >>
    }
    s.set_locale(&locale) or >>
    pages := &m.pages
    pagination := &pages[25]
    sizes :=[10, 20, 50, 100]
    for i in 0:4 {s.set_option_text(pagination.ids[2], i, locale.count_text(widgets.TEXT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE, sizes[i]) or >>) or >> }
    m.update_pagination(s, false) or >>
    // Business copy is supplied by the app, never silently translated by the widget.
    page := &m.pages[8]
    if index == 1 {s.set_task_labels(page.ids[0], "Building", "Built · run again", "Retry build", "Build again") or >> }
    else {s.set_task_labels(page.ids[0], "正在构建", "已构建 · 再次运行", "重试构建", "再次构建") or >> }
    $group_labels :=[["Undo", "Redo", "Save"],["Day", "Week", "Month"],["Bold", "Italic", "Underline"]]
    $type_labels :=["Line", "Area", "Bar", "Scatter", "Donut"]
    if index != 1 {group_labels =[["撤销", "重做", "保存"],["日", "周", "月"],["加粗", "斜体", "下划线"]]
        type_labels =["折线", "面积", "柱状", "散点", "环形"]}
    for mode in 0:3 {for i in 0:3 {s.set_button_group_label(m.pages[38].ids[mode],(i + 1) * 10, group_labels[mode][i]) or >> }}
    for i in 0:5 {s.set_button_group_label(m.pages[39].ids[1], i + 1, type_labels[i]) or >> }
    translated := workshop_menu_items(index == 1)
    for page_index in 42:45 {for item in translated{s.set_menu_item_label(m.pages[page_index].ids[0], item.key, item.label) or >> }}
    $menu_labels :=["Actions", "Right click here", "Save"]
    if index != 1 {menu_labels =["操作", "右键打开菜单", "保存"]}
    for page_index in 42:45 {s.set_menu_label(m.pages[page_index].ids[0], menu_labels[page_index - 42]) or >> }

    << 0
}

fn max_int_local(a int, b int) int {if a > b{ << a}
    << b}

fn (m &Workshop) open_preferences(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    pages := &m.pages
    page := &pages[33]
    s.set_value(page.ids[4], m.preferences_name) or >>
    s.set_toggle_value(page.ids[5], m.preferences_history) or >>
    s.set_field_invalid(page.ids[4], false) or >>
    s.open(page.ids[1]) or >>
    << 0
}

fn (m $&Workshop) pagination_invalid(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    m.pagination_error = true
    page := m.page_snapshot(25)
    data := s.pagination_data(page.ids[0]) or >>
    s.set_field_invalid(page.ids[1], true) or >>
    $message := "Enter a page from 1 to " + str(data.pages) + "."
    if(s.selected(m.language) or >>) != 1 {message = "请输入 1 至 " + str(data.pages) + " 之间的页码。"}
    if data.pages == 0 {message = "No pages / 暂无数据，无法跳页。"}
    s.set_text(page.ids[5], message) or >>
    << 0
}

fn (m $&Workshop) update_pagination(s $&widgets.Screen, sync_input bool) int {
    page := m.page_snapshot(25)
    data := s.pagination_data(page.ids[0]) or >>
    s.set_text(page.ids[3], s.pagination_summary(page.ids[0]) or >>) or >>
    s.set_enabled(page.ids[1], data.pages > 0) or >>
    s.set_enabled(page.ids[4], data.pages > 0) or >>
    if sync_input{
        m.pagination_error = false
        s.set_field_invalid(page.ids[1], false) or >>
        $text := ""
        if data.current >= 0 {text = str(data.current + 1)}
        s.set_value(page.ids[1], text) or >> }
    if m.pagination_error{m.pagination_invalid(s) or >> }
    else {$hint := "Enter ↵ · 1–" + str(data.pages)
        if data.pages == 0 {hint = "No data / 暂无数据"}
        s.set_text(page.ids[5], hint) or >> }
    << 0
}

fn (m &Workshop) update_badges(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    pages := &m.pages
    page := &pages[30]
    s.set_badge_count(page.ids[0], m.unread, 99, false) or >>
    s.set_text(page.ids[6], str(m.unread) + " unread · 点击收件箱清零，徽标随数字收紧。") or >>
    s.set_visible(page.ids[3], m.online) or >>
    $name := "林文 · Away 离线"
    if m.online{name = "林文 · Available 在线"}
    s.set_text(page.ids[7], name) or >>
    << 0
}

fn (m $&Workshop) work(s $&widgets.Screen, now time.Instant) int {
    if !m.running || now.before(m.deadline) { << 0}
    for i in 0:5000 {m.checksum =(m.checksum + i *(m.completed + 1)) % 1000003}
    m.completed += 1
    id := m.pages[8].ids[0]
    _ := s.set_task_progress(id, m.revision, f64(m.completed) / 48.0) or >>
    m.deadline = now.add(time.milliseconds(35) or >>) or >>
    if m.failure && m.completed == 18 {_ := s.complete_task(id, m.revision, widgets.TASK_ERROR) or >>
        m.running = false
        m.failure = false
        if m.selected == 8 {s.set_selected_button(m.tools[1], false) or >> }}
    else if m.completed == 48 {_ := s.complete_task(id, m.revision, widgets.TASK_SUCCESS) or >>
        m.running = false}
    << 0
}

fn (m &Workshop) range_summary(s $&widgets.Screen, committed bool) int {
    pages := &m.pages
    page := &pages[40]
    values := s.range_values(page.ids[0]) or >>
    $prefix := "Preview / 预览"
    if committed{prefix = "Committed / 已提交"}
    text := strconv.format_float(values.lower, 102, 0) or >>
    upper := strconv.format_float(values.upper, 102, 0) or >>
    s.set_text(page.ids[1], prefix + " · " + text + " – " + upper) or >>
    << 0
}

fn (m $&Workshop) configure_controls(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    position := m.selected
    page := m.page_snapshot(position)
    s.set_text(m.title, "XUUI  /  " + m.names[position]) or >>
    s.set_selected(m.navigation, position) or >>
    id := page.ids[0]
    state := s.selected(m.state) or >>
    s.set_enabled(id, state != 1) or >>
    if position == 45 {s.set_enabled(page.ids[1], state != 1) or >> }
    if position == 25 {s.set_enabled(page.group, state != 1) or >> }
    if read_only(m.selected) {s.set_read_only(id, state == 2) or >> }
    if invalid(m.selected) || m.selected == 31 || m.selected == 32 {s.set_invalid(id, state == 3) or >> }
    if position == 1 {for i in 0:9 {s.set_enabled(page.ids[i], state != 1) or >> }}
    if position == 38 {for i in 0:3 {
            s.set_button_group_item_enabled(page.ids[i], 20, !m.group_disabled) or >>
            s.set_enabled(page.ids[i], state != 1) or >>
            s.set_read_only(page.ids[i], state == 2) or >>
        }}
    if position == 39 {
        s.set_button_group_checked(page.ids[1], m.chart_kind + 1, true) or >>
        s.set_enabled(page.ids[1], state != 1) or >>
        s.set_read_only(page.ids[1], state == 2) or >>
    }
    s.set_enabled(m.motion, animated(m.selected) ||(m.selected >= 33 && m.selected <= 36)) or >>
    s.set_selected_button(m.custom, m.customized) or >>
    $custom_text := "Default 默认"
    if m.customized{custom_text = "Custom 自定义"}
    s.set_text(m.custom, custom_text) or >>
    $motion_text := "Motion 160ms"
    if m.slow{motion_text = "Motion 420ms"}
    s.set_text(m.motion, motion_text) or >>
    caption := description(m.selected)
    s.set_text(m.caption, caption) or >>
    $state_text := "Hover · press · Tab · arrows · Escape / 使用真实鼠标与键盘状态"
    if(state == 2 && !read_only(m.selected)) ||(state == 3 && !invalid(m.selected) && m.selected != 31 && m.selected != 32) {state_text = "此组件没有该状态。预览保持其实际语义。"}
    s.set_text(m.status, state_text) or >>
    labels := tool_labels(m.selected)
    for i in 0:3 {s.set_text(m.tools[i], labels[i]) or >>
        s.set_selected_button(m.tools[i], false) or >>
        s.set_enabled(m.tools[i], labels[i].len > 0) or >>
        s.set_visible(m.tools[i], labels[i].len > 0) or >> }
    if m.selected == 8 {s.set_selected_button(m.tools[1], m.failure) or >> }
    s.set_visible(m.focus, focusable_sample(m.selected)) or >>
    << 0
}

fn read_only(index int) bool { << index >= 38 ||(index >= 1 && index <= 26 && index != 8 && index != 25 && index != 26)}

fn invalid(index int) bool { << index >= 40 || index >= 1 && index <= 30 && index != 7 && index != 8 && index != 12 && index != 24 && index != 25 && index != 26 && index != 28}

fn animated(index int) bool { <<(index >= 38 && index <= 44) || index == 1 || index == 2 || index == 5 || index == 6 || index == 7 || index == 8 || index == 9 || index == 10 || index == 11 || index == 25}

fn appearance(styles &widgets.Styles, index int) widgets.ControlStyle{
    if index == 0 {$c := styles.input.clone()
        c.padding = layout.Insets{left: 0.0, top: 0.0, right: 0.0, bottom: 0.0}
        c.align_x = 0.0
        c.align_y = 0.0
        << c}
    if index == 7 { << styles.tree_style()}
    if index == 24 { << styles.table_style()}
    if index == 9 || index == 10 || index == 11 || index == 12 { << styles.checkbox.clone()}
    if index == 3 || index == 5 || index == 45 { << styles.input.clone()}
    if index == 4 || index == 6 { << styles.text_area.clone()}
    if index == 13 || index == 40 { << styles.slider_style()}
    if index == 41 { << styles.card_style()}
    if index == 14 { << styles.stepper_style()}
    if index == 15 { << styles.select_style()}
    if index == 21 || index == 22 { << styles.tabs_style()}
    if index == 23 { << styles.list_box_style()}
    if index == 27 { << styles.progress.clone()}
    if index == 29 { << styles.divider_style()}
    if index == 30 { << styles.badge_style()}
    if index == 31 { << styles.card_style()}
    if index == 32 { << styles.scroll.clone()}
    << styles.button.clone()
}

fn (m $&Workshop) apply_appearance(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    theme := s.selected(m.theme) or >>
    density := s.selected(m.density) or >>
    scale := s.selected(m.scale) or >>
    preset :=[widgets.THEME_LIGHT, widgets.THEME_DARK, widgets.THEME_CONTRAST][theme]
    $styles := widgets.preset_styles(preset) or >>
    styles.density =[1.0, 0.85, 1.25][density]
    styles.text_scale =[1.0, 1.4, 2.0][scale]
    sheet := widgets.screen_appearance(&styles, s.toggle_value(m.reduced) or >>) or >>
    s.apply_appearance(&sheet) or >>
    position := m.selected
    pages := &m.pages
    page := &pages[position]
    id := page.ids[0]
    if m.selected == 30 {$avatar := styles.button_variant(widgets.BUTTON_SUBTLE) or >>
        avatar.radius = 999.0
        s.set_control_style(page.ids[2], &avatar) or >> }
    if m.selected <= 32 || m.selected >= 40 {
        s.clear_control_style(id) or >>
        if m.customized{$c := appearance(&styles, m.selected)
            c.radius = 14.0
            c.border_width = 1.5
            c.padding.left += 4.0
            c.padding.right += 4.0
            s.set_control_style(id, &c) or >> }
    }
    $spec := widgets.motion_spec()
    if m.slow{spec.change = time.milliseconds(420) or >>
        spec.hover = time.milliseconds(320) or >>
        spec.enter = time.milliseconds(360) or >>
        spec.exit = time.milliseconds(240) or >>
        spec.curve = widgets.EASE_OUT_QUINT}
    if animated(m.selected) {s.set_motion(id, &spec) or >> }
    if m.selected == 1 {
        handles :=[page.ids[0], page.ids[1], page.ids[2], page.ids[3]]
        placements :=[widgets.ICON_LEADING, widgets.ICON_TRAILING, widgets.ICON_ABOVE, widgets.ICON_BELOW]
        for i in 0:4 {
            icon_size := s.number_value(page.ids[9 + i]) or >>
            s.set_text(page.ids[13 + i], "Icon 图标 · " + str(int(icon_size)) + " px") or >>
            $c := styles.button_variant(widgets.BUTTON_OUTLINE) or >>
            if i == 0 {c = styles.button_variant(widgets.BUTTON_PRIMARY) or >> }
            c.icon_placement = placements[i]
            c.icon_size = icon_size * styles.text_scale
            if m.customized{c.radius = 14.0
                c.border_width = 1.5}
            s.set_control_style(handles[i], &c) or >>
            s.set_motion(handles[i], &spec) or >>
        }
    }
    if m.selected == 33 || m.selected == 34 || m.selected == 36 {s.set_motion(page.ids[1], &spec) or >>
        $c := styles.overlay_style()
        if m.customized{c.radius = 18.0
            c.border_width = 2.0}
        s.set_control_style(page.ids[1], &c) or >> }
    if m.selected == 34 {
        $placement := widgets.overlay_placement()
        placement.side = m.tooltip_side
        placement.align = widgets.OVERLAY_CENTER
        s.set_tooltip_placement(page.ids[1], &placement) or >>
    }
    if m.selected == 35 {
        s.set_notice_motion(&spec) or >>
        if m.customized{$c := styles.overlay_style()
            c.radius = 18.0
            c.border_width = 2.0
            s.set_notice_style(&c) or >> }
        else {s.clear_notice_style() or >> }
    }
    if m.selected == 38 {
        $group_appearance := widgets.button_group_appearance()
        group_appearance.vertical = m.group_vertical
        group_appearance.joined = m.group_joined
        for i in 0:3 {s.set_button_group_appearance(page.ids[i], &group_appearance) or >>
            s.clear_control_style(page.ids[i]) or >>
            s.set_motion(page.ids[i], &spec) or >>
            if m.customized{$c := styles.button_variant(widgets.BUTTON_OUTLINE) or >>
                c.radius = 12.0
                c.border_width = 1.5
                s.set_control_style(page.ids[i], &c) or >> }}
    }
    if m.selected == 39 {
        s.clear_control_style(id) or >>
        $appearance := widgets.chart_appearance()
        appearance.y_unit = " ms"
        if m.chart_kind == widgets.CHART_DONUT{appearance.y_unit = ""}
        if m.customized{appearance.grid = false
            appearance.area_opacity = 0.26
            appearance.inner_radius = 0.78
            appearance.palette =[draw.rgb(41, 126, 178), draw.rgb(215, 146, 42), draw.rgb(56, 153, 124)]
            $c := styles.card_style()
            c.radius = 18.0
            s.set_control_style(id, &c) or >> }
        s.set_chart_appearance(id, &appearance) or >>
        $options := widgets.animation_options()
        options.duration = time.milliseconds(650) or >>
        options.curve = widgets.EASE_IN_OUT_CUBIC
        if m.slow{options.duration = time.milliseconds(1200) or >> }
        s.set_chart_animation(id, &options) or >>
        if m.chart_paused{s.pause_chart_animation(id) or >> }
    }
    if m.selected == 40 {
        $options := widgets.range_slider_options()
        options.step = 5.0
        options.min_distance = 10.0
        if m.range_push{options.collision = widgets.RANGE_PUSH}
        options.vertical = m.range_vertical
        options.commit_only = m.range_commit
        s.set_range_options(id, &options) or >>
        $appearance := widgets.slider_appearance()
        appearance.ticks = 11
        appearance.show_value = true
        s.set_range_appearance(id, &appearance) or >>
    }
    if m.selected == 41 {
        $options := widgets.split_view_options()
        options.vertical = m.split_vertical
        options.minimum_first = 120.0 * styles.text_scale
        options.minimum_second = 140.0 * styles.text_scale
        s.set_split_options(id, &options) or >>
    }
    if m.selected >= 42 && m.selected <= 44 {
        $appearance := widgets.menu_appearance()
        appearance.close_on_select = !m.menu_stays_open
        s.set_menu_appearance(id, &appearance) or >>
    }
    if m.selected == 37 {$radius := 8.0
        if m.customized{radius = 18.0}
        s.set_webview_radius(id, radius) or >> }
    << 0
}

// Business handlers set option flags. Appearance changes run only here.
fn (m $&Workshop) apply_page_options(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    if m.tree_options_dirty{
        $appearance := widgets.tree_appearance()
        appearance.guides = m.guided
        s.set_tree_appearance(m.pages[7].ids[0], &appearance) or >>
        m.tree_options_dirty = false
    }
    if m.field_options_dirty{
        $decoration := widgets.field_decoration(&"Project name 项目名称")
        decoration.variant =(m.variant - 1) % 3
        decoration.floating =(m.variant - 1) % 4
        decoration.helper = "Floating / fixed label and stable helper area"
        decoration.error = "Please enter a valid name."
        decoration.clearable = true
        s.set_field_decoration(m.pages[m.field_options_page].ids[0], &decoration) or >>
        m.field_options_dirty = false
    }
    if m.spinner_options_dirty{
        s.set_spinner_appearance(m.pages[28].ids[0], 48.0, 4.0, time.milliseconds(1200) or >>) or >>
        m.spinner_options_dirty = false
    }
    if m.popover_options_dirty{
        $placement := widgets.overlay_placement()
        placement.side = m.variant
        placement.align = widgets.OVERLAY_CENTER
        s.set_popover_placement(m.pages[33].ids[1], &placement) or >>
        m.popover_options_dirty = false
    }
    << 0
}

fn new_page(s $&widgets.Screen, index int) Page{
    group := s.group() or >>
    $ids :=[]int {}
    choices :=["Workspace 工作区", "History 历史", "Output 输出"]

fn description(index int) string {
    if index == 45 { << "按 Unicode 字素掩码；显隐切换、原生编辑、只读与禁用，禁止复制或剪切密码。"}
    if index == 40 { << "双端区间：步进、最小间距、端点推挤、整段拖动；独立焦点与提交。"}
    if index == 41 { << "可调整分栏：尺寸约束、折叠恢复、键盘调整；内容保持在各自面板内。"}
    if index >= 42 && index <= 44 { << "动作 / 勾选 / 单选 / 子菜单；键盘、边缘翻转、快捷键与可定制的逐项反馈。"}
    if index == 38 { << "独立操作 / 单选 / 多选；逐项禁用，方向键导航，Enter 或空格激活。"}
    if index == 39 { << "原生交互图表：稳定 ID 数据过渡、悬停/选中、图例；Ctrl/⌘ + 滚轮缩放，拖动平移，双击复位。"}
    descriptions :=["正文、标题与辅助文字分层；原生换行与字体覆盖。",
    "图标左 / 右 / 上 / 下；各自调节尺寸，按钮按内容宽度自动换行。",
    "独立点击目标与动作名称；键盘焦点也能查看提示。",
    "原生单行编辑：选区、复制、粘贴与 IME。",
    "原生多行编辑：段落、内部滚动与输入法候选定位。",
    "浮动标签 / 固定标签 / 三种边框；软计数不截断输入。",
    "多行 Field：最小 3 行、最大 6 行；计数与稳定辅助区。",
    "层级引导、矢量箭头、图标、元数据、筛选和节点动作。",
    "真实计算批次驱动进度；任务 ID 拒绝旧回调。",
    "整行点击；混合态；可中断的勾选显现。",
    "轨道与圆钮过渡；快速切换可中断；只读保留焦点。",
    "单项选择与选中动效；完整标签点击目标。",
    "方向键管理互斥；Tab 只进入一次。",
    "11 个刻度、10 步吸附、数值提示；松开才提交。",
    "按住连续增加并加速；到达边界停止。",
    "有类型的分组 / 禁用选项；方向键跳过不可选行。",
    "本地匹配高亮与无结果；可控制是否接受自由输入。",
    "候选筛选、可移除标签、全选和清空。",
    "今天 / 清空；Page Up/Down 快速翻月，Shift 切年。",
    "12/24 小时可选；存储保持明确的时间值。",
    "RGBA 通道、HEX 精确输入、色板与最近颜色。",
    "可变宽标签；方向键移动，Enter 手动激活。",
    "与 Tabs 分开的选中底板和容器语义。",
    "图标 / 主副文本 / 尾部信息；字体放大后命中保持一致。",
    "拖动调整列宽；横向与纵向滚动；数据状态文字。",
    "首页、末页与省略项；大页数仍可快速定位。",
    "保留当前路径；中间段收进可交互的菜单。",
    "真实确定进度与缓冲区分别显示，不伪造百分比。",
    "大小 / 粗细 / 周期可配置；减少动效显示静态反馈。",
    "弱分隔与章节文字组合；水平和垂直使用同一规范。",
    "Badge 放入真实上下文：未读计数、头像状态点与列表标签。",
    "Header / body / footer 内容槽；动作使用独立 Button。",
    "真实子控件裁剪、滚轮冒泡、轨道拖动与键盘焦点滚入。",
    "锚点定位、边缘翻转；外点 / Escape 关闭。",
    "Hover 延迟、focus 立即显示；Escape 抑制重复提示。",
    "最多三条可见通知；队列、去重、优先级与撤销动作。",
    "模态焦点循环与恢复；安全动作先获得焦点。",
    "原生网页子视图作为 Screen 组件，支持裁剪与独立生命周期。"]
    << descriptions[index]
}

fn tool_labels(index int)[]string {
    if index == 45 { <<["Clear 清空", "Reset 示例", "Focus 输入"]}
    if index == 40 { <<["Clamp / push 端点", "Commit mode 提交", "Orientation 方向"]}
    if index == 41 { <<["Orientation 方向", "Collapse / restore 折叠", "Reset 复位"]}
    if index >= 42 && index <= 44 { <<["Open 打开", "Keep open 保持展开", "Disable export 禁用导出"]}
    if index == 38 { <<["Disable middle 逐项禁用", "Orientation 方向", "Joined / gap 拼接"]}
    if index == 39 { <<["Update data 更新数据", "Reset zoom 复位", "Pause / resume 暂停"]}
    if index == 0 { <<["Long text 长文", "Short text 短文", ""]}
    if index == 1 || index == 2 { <<["Select 选中", "Clear selection", ""]}
    if index == 3 || index == 4 { <<["Empty 清空", "Long text 长文", ""]}
    if index == 5 || index == 6 { <<["Empty 清空", "Long text 长文", "Appearance 外观"]}
    if index == 7 { <<["Guides 引导线", "Reveal last 定位", "Clear filter"]}
    if index == 8 { <<["Progress 外观", "Fail next 下次失败", "Cancel 取消"]}
    if index == 9 { <<["Mixed 混合态", "Checked 勾选", "Unchecked"]}
    if index == 10 { <<["Pending 等待", "Resolve 成功", "Fail 恢复"]}
    if index == 11 { <<["On 选中", "Off 取消", ""]}
    if index == 13 { <<["Apply input", "Commit only", "Live updates"]}
    if index == 15 { <<["Open 展开", "Disabled option", ""]}
    if index == 16 { <<["Allow custom 自由", "Options only", "Clear 清空"]}
    if index == 17 { <<["Select all 全选", "Clear 清空", ""]}
    if index == 18 { <<["Clear 清空", "Set today 今天", ""]}
    if index == 19 { <<["12 hour", "24 hour", "Hide seconds"]}
    if index == 20 { <<["Apply HEX", "Cinnabar 朱砂", "Transparent"]}
    if index == 24 { <<["Data 数据", "Loading 加载", "Error 错误"]}
    if index == 25 { <<["Jump 跳转", "Last 末页", "Data 空/满"]}
    if index == 27 { <<["0%", "42%", "100%"]}
    if index == 28 { <<["Run 开始", "Stop 停止", "Large 大号"]}
    if index == 30 { <<["+1 未读", "Clear 清零", "99+ 溢出"]}
    if index == 32 { <<["Top 顶部", "Bottom 底部", "Focus last"]}
    if index == 33 { <<["Open 打开", "Close 关闭", "Position 方位"]}
    if index == 34 { <<["Focus 提示", "Blur 隐藏", "Position 方位"]}
    if index == 35 { <<["Enqueue 通知", "Undo", "Burst 三条"]}
    if index == 36 { <<["Open 打开", "Close 关闭", ""]}
    if index == 37 { <<["Reload 重载", "Hide 隐藏", "Show 恢复"]}
    <<["", "", ""]
}

fn workshop_menu_items(english bool)[]widgets.MenuItem{
    labels :=["Open workspace", "Show grid", "Export", "PNG image", "SVG image", "Unavailable", "Save", "View density", "Compact", "Comfortable"]
    $translated := labels
    if !english{translated =["打开工作区", "显示网格", "导出", "PNG 图片", "SVG 图片", "暂不可用", "保存", "视图密度", "紧凑", "舒适"]}
    $grid := widgets.menu_item(20, translated[1])
    grid.kind = widgets.MENU_CHECK
    $export := widgets.menu_item(30, translated[2])
    export.kind = widgets.MENU_SUBMENU
    $png := widgets.menu_item(31, translated[3])
    png.parent = 30
    $svg := widgets.menu_item(32, translated[4])
    svg.parent = 30
    $unavailable := widgets.menu_item(40, translated[5])
    unavailable.enabled = false
    $save := widgets.menu_item(50, translated[6])
    save.shortcut_key = 115
    save.shortcut_modifiers = ui.MOD_META
    save.shortcut_label = "⌘S"
    $separator := widgets.menu_item(60, "")
    separator.kind = widgets.MENU_SEPARATOR
    $heading := widgets.menu_item(70, translated[7])
    heading.kind = widgets.MENU_HEADING
    $compact := widgets.menu_item(80, translated[8])
    compact.kind = widgets.MENU_RADIO
    compact.radio_group = 1
    $comfortable := widgets.menu_item(81, translated[9])
    comfortable.kind = widgets.MENU_RADIO
    comfortable.radio_group = 1
    comfortable.checked = true
    <<[widgets.menu_item(10, translated[0]), grid, export, png, svg, unavailable, save, separator, heading, compact, comfortable]
}

fn chart_data(kind int, revision int)[]widgets.ChartSeries{
    $result :=[]widgets.ChartSeries{}
    $series_count := 2
    if kind == widgets.CHART_DONUT{series_count = 1}
    for si in 0:series_count{
        $name := "Build 构建"
        if si == 1 {name = "Index 索引"}
        if kind == widgets.CHART_DONUT{name = "Workload 工作量"}
        $series := widgets.chart_series(si + 1, name, kind)
        series.smooth = kind == widgets.CHART_LINE || kind == widgets.CHART_AREA
        $count := 12 - revision % 2
        if kind == widgets.CHART_SCATTER{count = 64}
        if kind == widgets.CHART_DONUT{count = 5}
        for i in 0:count{
            x := f64(i + 1)
            phase := f64(revision) * 0.9 + f64(si) * 1.7
            y := 48.0 + f64(si) * 20.0 + math.sin(x * 0.55 + phase) * 20.0 + math.cos(x * 0.17 + phase) * 7.0
            $point := widgets.chart_point(i + 1, x, y)
            point.label = "Sample 样本 " + str(i + 1)
            if kind == widgets.CHART_DONUT{point.label =["Compile 编译", "Index 索引", "Render 绘制", "I/O 输入输出", "Other 其他"][i]}
            series.points.push(point)
        }
        result.push(series)
    }
    << result
}

struct ColorPicker

XuAPI
pub struct ColorPicker {

}

Purpose

Inline RGBA picker: four quantized 0..255 channels and a checkerboard alpha preview. Up/Down selects a channel; Left/Right, Home/End and Page keys adjust it. Each channel is also a draggable Slider. This is deliberately a small RGB editor rather than an HSV spectrum, OS eyedropper or color-profile tool.

Parameters

none

struct ComboBox

XuAPI
pub struct ComboBox {

}

Purpose

Editable choice field. Text is owned by Editor and travels through the native TextInput revision/IME protocol, including composition, clipboard and Unicode. Call event for native events and place_combo_box after each View layout. route receives node-local input; input receives canvas coordinates, which lets the scene intercept an open popup before dispatching an outside press. paint_styled paints locally like Editor; paint_popup_styled is canvas-space.

Parameters

none

struct Modal

XuAPI
pub struct Modal {

}

Purpose

Modal owns the keyboard focus order, while the host owns the actual child controls. Use blocks_input as the dispatch gate, including the closing fade. Cancel background View input before open (cancel_input) to release capture and native editor focus. Apply focused_id after open/input, and restore take_restore_focus after tick reports the closing fade finished. Never dispatch to background while blocks_input first call input, honor consumed even when that input closes the modal, then dispatch only to modal children if allows_content.

Parameters

none
